Toe Mosi mah, To tiah loe amsoem mak ai; Kaicae Angraeng Sithaw khaeah, ka sak o ih angbawnhaih loe Izip kaminawk hanah panuet thok hmuen ah om tih; khenah, nangcae mikhnuk ah Izip kaminawk panuet thok ah angbawnhaih to ka sak o nahaeloe, thlung hoi na va o mak ai maw?
To pongah ni thumto caehhaih praezaek ah ka caeh o moe, ang thuih ih lok baktih toengah, kaicae Angraeng Sithaw khaeah, angbawnhaih to ka sak o han, tiah a naa.
Faro mah, Praezaek ah nangmacae ih Angraeng Sithaw khaeah, angbawnhaih sak hanah kang caeh o sak han; toe kangthla ah caeh o hmah; vaihi kai hanah lawk na thui paeh, tiah a naa.
Mosi mah, Khenah, nang khae hoi ka tacawt pacoengah, khawnbang hoi kamtong, taksaenawk mah Faro hoi a tamnanawk, angmah ih kaminawk to tacawt taak hanah, Angraeng khaeah lawk ka thuih roep han; toe Israel kaminawk Angraeng khaeah angbawnhaih sak o thai hanah, Faro mah na ling hmah nasoe loe, caehsak ai ah om hmah nasoe, tiah a naa.
To pacoengah Mosi mah Faro to caehtaak moe, Angraeng khaeah lawk a thuih.
Mosi mah hnik ih lok baktih toengah, Angraeng mah sak pae; taksaenawk loe Faro hoi a tamnanawk, anih ih kaminawk khae hoiah tacawt o; to pacoeng hoiah loe taksae to om ai boeh.
To nathuem ah doeh Faro loe palung thah vop moe, kaminawk to caehsak ai.
To pacoengah Angraeng mah Mosi khaeah, Faro khaeah caeh ah loe, Hebrunawk ih Angraeng Sithaw mah, Kai a bok o hanah, kai ih kaminawk to tacawtsak lai ah, tiah a thuih, tiah thuih paeh, tiah ang naa.
Nihcae to na caehsak ai ah, na patawn caeng nahaeloe,
khenah, Angraeng loe lawk ah kaom pacah ih moinawk, hrangnawk, laa hrangnawk, kaengkuu hrangnawk, maitaw taenawk, tuunawk nuiah ban to phok ueloe, karai parai nathaih to phasak tih.
Toe Angraeng mah, Israel kaminawk ih moinawk hoi Izip kaminawk ih moinawk to ka tapraek han, Israel kaminawk ih moi loe maeto doeh dueh mak ai, tiah a thuih, tiah thui paeh, tiah a naa.
Angraeng mah atue to pahoe boeh, Angraeng mah khawnbang ah hae hmuen hae prae thungah sah tih, tiah thuih.
Angraeng mah khawnbang ah to hmuen to sak; Izip kaminawk ih moi loe duek o boih; toe Israel kaminawk ih moinawk loe maeto doeh dueh ai.
Faro mah kami to patoeh naah, khenah, Israel kaminawk ih moi loe maeto doeh dueh ai, tito panoek; toe Faro loe palung amtaaksak toengtoeng vop moe, Israel kaminawk to tacawtsak ai.
To pacoengah Angraeng mah Mosi hoi Aaron khaeah, Takoeng ih maiphu to ban tamsum maeto la hoih, Mosi mah Faro hmaa ah van bangah haeh nasoe.
To maiphu loe Izip prae thung boih ah koi ueloe, Izip prae thungah kaom kaminawk hoi moinawk to, ahlut mansak boih tih, tiah a naa.
To pongah nihnik mah takoeng pong ih maiphu to a lak hoi moe, Faro hmaa ah angdoet hoi; Mosi mah maiphu to van ah haeh naah, kaminawk hoi moinawk nuiah ahlut to oh.
Miklet kop kaminawk hoi Izip kaminawk boih ahlut manh o pongah, Mosi hmaa ah angdoe o thai ai.
Mosi khaeah Angraeng mah thuih ih lok baktih toengah, Angraeng mah Faro to palung thahsak, to pongah Mosi hoi Aaron ih lok to tahngai pae ai.
To pacoengah Angraeng mah Mosi khaeah, Khawnthaw ah angthawk ah loe, Faro hmaa ah angdoe ah, anih khaeah, Hebru kaminawk ih Angraeng Sithaw mah, Kai a bok o hanah, kai ih kaminawk to tacawtsak lai ah, tiah a thuih, tiah thui pae hanah a naa.
Vaihi loe long pum ah kai baktih mi doeh om ai, tiah na panoek hanah, na palung thungah maw, na tamnanawk hoi kaminawk nuiah maw, raihaihnawk to ka phaksak han boeh.
Vaihi ban ka payangh moe, nangmah hoi nang ih kaminawk nuiah raihaih ka phaksak han, nang loe long hoiah kang hmatsak han boeh.
Toe na nuiah ka thacakhaih to kam tuengsak moe, long boih ah ka hmin taphong han ih ni, nang hae kang pathawk tahang.
Toe nang mah kai kaminawk ih lok to na aek, nangmah hoi nangmah to nam koeh moe, kai ih kaminawk prawt ai ah na oh han maw?
Khenah, khawnbang hae atue ah, Izip prae oh tangsuek nathuem hoi kamtong vaihi khoek to kaom vai ai, kanung parai qaetui to ka kraksak han.
To pongah vaihi kami to patoeh ah loe, lawk ah kaom moinawk hoi na tawnh ih hmuennawk boih pakuemsak ah; im ah hoih ai ih lawk ah kaom kami hoi moinawk loe qaetui mah va boih ueloe, dueh o boih tih, tiah thuih, tiah a thuisak.
Angraeng ih lok zii kami, Faro ih tamnanawk loe angmacae ih tamnanawk hoi pacah ih moinawk to im ah hoih o.
Toe Angraeng ih lok tidoeh sah ai kaminawk loe, angmacae tamnanawk hoi pacah ih moinawk to lawk ah caeh o taak.
To pacoengah Angraeng mah Mosi khaeah, Kaminawk, moinawk hoi Izip prae boih ah kaom lawk ih aannawk nuiah qaetui to kraksak hanah, van bangah na ban to payang ah, tiah a naa.
Mosi mah angmah ih cunghet to van ah phok tahang naah, Angraeng mah khopazih hoi qaetui to patoeh, hmai to long ah krak; Angraeng mah Izip prae thungah qaetui to kho baktiah angzohsak.
To tiah kakrah qaetui loe, hmai hoiah angbaeh; Izip prae oh tangsuek nathuem hoiah to baktih kanung parai, qaetui to om vai ai vop.
Qaetui mah Izip prae thung boih ih lawk, kami, pacah ih moi, lawk ah kamprawk aannawk to vah boih moe, lawk ih thingnawk doeh angkhaehsak boih.
Israel kaminawk ohhaih Goshen ahmuen khue ah ni, qaetui krah ai ah oh.
To pacoengah Faro mah Mosi hoi Aaron to kawk hanah kami to patoeh, nihnik khaeah, Vaihi hmuen kasak pazae boeh, Angraeng loe toeng, kai hoi kai ih kaminawk loe ka set o boeh.
(Khawt boeh); khopazih hoi qaetui to dip thai hanah, Angraeng khaeah lawkthui ah; kang caeh o sak han boeh hmang; kasawk ah na om o mak ai boeh, tiah a naa.
Mosi mah anih khaeah, Vangpui zaeh ah ka caeh moe, Angraeng khaeah ban ka payangh han, to naah khopazih hoi qaetui to dii roep tih; to tiah ni long loe Angraeng ih ni, tito na panoek tih.
Toe nang hoi na tamnanawk mah Angraeng to na zii o mak ai vop, tito ka panoek, tiah a naa.
Buri sakhaih akung hoi barli cang loe amro boeh; barli cang loe aquih tacawt boeh moe, buri sakhaih akung doeh apawk pawk boeh.
Takaw dip sakhaih cang hoi bungaih loe amprawk ai vop pongah, amro ai.
To pacoengah Mosi loe Faro khae hoiah tacawt moe, vangpui zaeh ah a caeh; Angraeng khaeah a ban to payangh, to naah khopazih hoi qaetui to dip moe, long nuiah kho angzo ai boeh.
Khotui, qaetui hoi khopazih to dip boeh, tiah Faro mah hnuk naah, zaehaih a sak let bae vop; angmah hoi a tamnanawk doeh palungthah o let.
Angraeng mah Mosi khaeah thuih ih lok baktih toengah, Faro loe palungthah moe, Israel kaminawk to tacawtsak ai.
To pacoengah Angraeng mah Mosi khaeah, Faro khaeah caeh ah; anih hmaa ah hae baktih dawnrai hmuennawk kam tuengsak hanah, anih hoi a tamnanawk ih palungthin to kam taksak boeh;
Izip prae nuiah ka sak ih hmuen hoi nihcae khaeah ka sak ih dawnrai hmuennawk to, na capa hoi na capa ih capa patoeng khaeah thui paeh, tiah a naa.
To pongah Mosi hoi Aaron loe Faro khaeah caeh hoi moe, anih khaeah, Hebru kaminawk ih Angraeng Sithaw mah, Ka hmaa ah poek pahnaem hanah nasetto maw nang maak han vop? Kai a bok o hanah, kai ih kaminawk to tacawtsak lai ah.
Na tacawtsak ai nahaeloe, khenah, khawnbang ah na prae thung boih ah pakhuh kang tacawtsak han;
pakhuh loe long ah koi o boih tih, long to na hnu o thai mak ai; nihcae loe qaetui mah bop ai ih kanghmat, lawk ah kamprawk aannawk hoi thingnawk to caa o king tih.
Nam panawk hoi nam panawk ih ampanawk mah hae long nuiah khosak o tangsuek nathuem hoi kamtong vaihni ni khoek to hnu o vai ai ih, to baktih pakhuhnawk loe na im, na tamnanawk ih im hoi Izip kaminawk ih im boih ah koi o tih, tiah a thuih, tiah a thuih pae hoi; to pacoengah Mosi mah Faro to caehtaak.
Faro ih tamnanawk mah anih khaeah, Hae kami mah aicae han nasetto maw thaang patung o vop tih? Angmacae ih Angraeng Sithaw to a bok o hanah, nihcae to tacawtsak lai ah; Izip prae loe amro boeh, tiah na panoek ai vop maw? tiah a naa o.
To pacoengah Mosi hoi Aaron to Faro khaeah kawk o let; Faro mah nihnik khaeah, Caeh hoi ah loe, na Angraeng Sithaw to bok oh; toe mi kawbaktih kaminawk maw caeh o tih? tiah a naa.
Mosi mah, Angraeng khaeah poihsak han oh pongah, thendoengnawk, mitongnawk, kaimacae ih capa hoi canunawk, tuunawk hoi maitawnawk hoi nawnto ka caeh o han, tiah a naa.
To naah Faro mah, Caeh hanah nangcae hoi nawktanawk kang prawt o baktih toengah, nangcae khaeah Angraeng to om nasoe; acoe oh; kasae sak han na poek o bae hae!
To tiah poek han om ai! Nongpanawk khue caeh o nasoe loe, canghni ah nang hnik o ih baktih toengah, Angraeng to bok o nasoe, tiah a naa. To naah Mosi hoi Aaron to Faro hmaa hoiah haek o ving.
To naah Angraeng mah Mosi khaeah, Izip prae thungah pakhuh angzoh moe, qaetui mah tahmat ih, long ah amprawk aankungnawk to caak boih hanah, na ban to Izip prae nuiah payangh ah, tiah a naa.
To pongah Mosi mah a ban ih cunghet to Izip prae nuiah phok; to na niah aqum athun Angraeng mah ni angzae bang ih takhi to songsak; khawnbang phak naah loe takhi mah pakhuhnawk to caeh haih boih.
Izip prae thung boih ah pakhu to koi, Izip prae angzithaih ramri taeng khoek to, kroek laek ai ah oh o; to baktih pakhuhnawk loe natuek naah doeh to tiah om vai ai; angzo han koi atue ah doeh to tiah om mak ai.
Long boih ah koi o pongah, long loe amnum ving; qaetui mah bop ai ih kanghmat, lawk ah kamprawk aankungnawk hoi thingkung pong ih kanghmat thingthainawk to a caak o boih; Izip prae thung boih ah thingkung kahing, to ai boeh loe lawk ih aannawk roe om ai boeh.
Faro mah Mosi hoi Aaron to karangah kawk moe, Nangcae ih Angraeng Sithaw hoi nanghnik nuiah zaehaih ka sak moeng boeh.
To pongah vaihi ka zaehaih to tahmen ah loe, na Angraeng Sithaw mah hae duekhaih maeto hae kai khae hoiah takhoe ving hanah, lawk na thui paeh, tiah a naa.
Mosi mah Faro to tacawt taak moe, Angraeng khaeah lawk a thuih.
To naah Angraeng mah thacak takhi to niduem bang hoiah songsak moe, pakhuhnawk to tuipui kathim thungah hmuh pae boih; Izip prae thung boih ah pakhuh maeto doeh anghmat ai boeh.
Toe Angraeng mah Faro to palungthahsak toengtoeng vop pongah, Israel kaminawk to prawt ai.
To pacoengah Angraeng mah Mosi khaeah, Khoving mah Izip prae to khuk khoep hanah, van bangah na ban to payangh ah, tiah a naa.
To pongah Mosi mah van bangah ban to payangh; to naah kathah parai khoving mah Izip prae to ni thumto thung khuk khoep.
Maeto hoi maeto ang hnuh o thai ai moe, ni thumto thung naa ah doeh caeh o thai ai; toe Israel kaminawk ohhaih ahmuen ah loe aanghaih to oh.
To naah Faro mah Mosi to kawk moe, anih khaeah, Caeh oh loe Angraeng to bok oh; nongpata hoi nawktanawk doeh caeh o boih ah; tuunawk hoi maitawnawk khue to caeh o taak ah, tiah a naa.
Toe Mosi mah anih khaeah, Kaicae Angraeng Sithaw khaeah angbawnhaih hoi hmuen paekhaih ka sak o haih hanah moi hoi hmuennawk to na paek ah.
Ka pacah o ih moinawk doeh ka caeh o haih han; maeto doeh ka caeh o taak mak ai; to moinawk loe kaimacae ih Angraeng Sithaw to bok hanah ka patoh o han; to ahmuen ka pha o ai karoek to, kaimacae ih Angraeng Sithaw to kawbaktih moi hoiah maw ka bok o han, tito ka panoek o ai vop, tiah a naa.
Toe Angraeng mah Faro palungthahsak pongah, nihcae to caehsak han koeh ai.
Faro mah Mosi khaeah, Ka hmaa hoi tacawt ah, kai tongh hanah angzo let hmah lai ah! Ka mikhmai na hnuk lethaih ni loe, na duekhaih niah om tih boeh, tiah a naa.
Mosi mah, Na thuih ih lok loe hoih; na hmaa ah kam tueng let mak ai boeh, tiah a naa.
Angraeng mah Mosi khaeah, Faro hoi Izip prae nuiah raihaih maeto ka phaksak han vop; to pacoengah loe hae ahmuen hoiah na tacawtsak tih boeh; to tiah nawnto na haek o boih ueloe, na tacawt o sak tih boeh.
Israel nongpa maw, nongpata maw, mi kawbaktih mah doeh angmacae imtaeng kami khaeah sui hoi sum kanglungnawk hnik hanah, kaminawk khaeah thui paeh, tiah a naa.
Kai mah Izip kaminawk khaeah kami tahmenhaih palungthin to ka paek han; Mosi doeh Faro tamnanawk hmaa hoi Izip prae thungah paroeai ka lensak han.
To pongah Angraeng mah khoving ah Izip prae um ah ka caeh han, tiah thuih, tiah Mosi mah thuih.
Izip prae thungah caa lu to ka dueksak boih han; angraeng tangkhang nuiah anghnu, Faro ih caa lu hoi amtong ueloe, cang kaehhaih set hnuk ah anghnu tamna nongpata ih caa lu khoek to ka dueksak han; tapen tangsuek moinnawk doeh ka dueksak boih han.
Izip prae thung boih canghnii ah kaom vai ai, hmabang ah doeh kaom han ai, qahhaih to om tih.
Toe Israel kaminawk ohhaih ahmuen ah loe kami, to tih ai boeh loe moi mataeng doeh ui mah uk mak ai; to naah Angraeng mah Izip kaminawk hoi Israel kaminawk tapraek boeh, tito na panoek o tih, tiah a thuih.
Hae ih na tamnanawk boih kai khaeah angzoh o moe, ka hmaa ah akuep o pacoengah, nangmah hoi na hnukbang kaminawk to tacawt o boih lai ah, tiah na thuih pacoengah ni ka caeh han vop, tiah a naa. Mosi loe palungphui moe, Faro to tacawt taak.
Angraeng mah Mosi khaeah, Izip prae thung boih ah Kai ih dawnrai hmuen to pung han oh pongah, Faro mah na lok to tahngai mak ai, tiah a naa.
Mosi hoi Aaron mah Faro hmaa ah hae baktih dawnrai hmuennawk boih a sak hoi; toe Angraeng mah Faro ih palung thahsak pongah, a prae thung hoiah Israel kaminawk tacawtsak ai toengtoeng vop.
Izip prae ah Angraeng mah Mosi hoi Aaron khaeah,
Vaihi khrah loe nangcae han khrah tangsuek ah om tih; nangcae han saning amtong tangsuekhaih khrah ah om tih.
Vaihi khrah ni hato naah, kami boih, angmacae imthung takoh maeto mah, tuucaa maeto sin hanah, amkhueng Israel kaminawk boih khaeah thui ah, tiah a naa.
Imthung takoh maeto hanah tuucaa maeto khawt ai nahaeloe, a imtaeng ih kami hoi angcuu o nasoe loe, kami khawt ah tuucaa to sin o nasoe.
Coek koi kaom ai, saningto kaom Tuu tae to sin oh; to loe Tuu, to tih ai boeh loe Ma-eh thung hoiah qoi oh;
to khrah ni hatlai palito pha ai karoek to tuucaa to kahoih ah khen oh loe, ani phak naah amkhueng Israel kaminawk mah to tuucaa to khoving ah bop o tih.
Athii to la oh loe, tuu moi na caak o haih im thok ranuih hoi thok tung ranui ah nok oh.
To na ni duembang ah, hmai pakhaem ih moi to, kakhaa aan hoi taeh thuh ai ih takaw hoiah nawnto caa oh.
Kahaeng moi maw, to tih ai boeh loe tui hoiah bueh ih moi to caa o hmah; toe a lu moi, a khok hoi palung pathinnawk loe hmai pakhaem pacoengah caa oh.
Moi to khawnbang khoek to suem o hmah; kamthlai zetta om nahaeloe, hmai hoiah qoeng oh.
Moi na caak o naah, kaengkaeh to angzaeng oh, khokpanaibum abuen oh loe, ban ah cunghet to sin pacoengah, karangah caa oh; hae loe Angraeng ih loihhaih poih ah oh.
To na ni qum ah Izip prae thung boih ah ka caeh moe, kaminawk ih caa lu hoi tapen tangsuek moi to ka dueksak boih han; Izip sithawnawk to lok ka caek boih han; Kai loe Angraeng ah ka oh.
Athii loe nangcae ohhaih im ah, angmathaih maeto ah om tih; athii ka hnuk naah, nangcae to kang takanh taak han; Izip prae ka tuk naah, nangcae nuiah kasae nathaih pha mak ai.
Hae ani hae pakuem o poe ah; na caanawk dung khoek to hae ani phak naah, Angraeng khaeah buh raenghaih poih to sah oh; sakzong ih atawk baktih toengah, to poih to dungzan khoek to sah oh.
Ni sarihto thung taeh thuh ai ih takaw to caa oh; ni amtong tangsuek naah imthung ih taeh to va oh; ni amtong tangsuek hoi ni sarihto thung taeh thuh ih takaw caa kami loe, Israel acaeng thung hoiah pahnawt oh.
Amtong tangsuekhaih ni hoi sarihto niah, kaciim amkhuenghaih to sah oh; caaknaek khue ai ah loe tok kalah roe sah o hmah.
Hae na ni roe ah Izip prae thung hoiah kang tacawt o haih pongah, taeh thuh ai ih takaw caakhaih poih to sah oh; sakzong ih atawk baktih toengah, na caanawk dung khoek to hae ani hae zaa o poe ah.
Khrah tangsuek, to akhrah ni hathlai palito duembang hoi kamtong ni pumphaeto pacoeng, nito duembang karoek to taeh thuh ai ih takaw to caa oh.
Ni sarihto thung na imthung ah taeh to suem o hmah; angvin maw, to tih ai boeh loe prae thung tapen kami mah maw, taeh thuh ih takaw to caa nahaeloe, Israel acaeng thung hoiah pahnawt oh.
Taeh hoi sak ih takaw to caa o hmah; na ohhaih ahmuen kruekah taeh thuh ai ih takaw to caa oh, tiah a naa.
To pacoengah Mosi mah Israel kacoehtanawk to kawk boih moe, nihcae khaeah, Caeh oh, nangmacae imthung takoh kakhawt ah, tuucaa maeto la oh loe, loihhaih poih sak hanah bop oh.
Hissop thing tadok tamsum maeto la oh, sabae kathuk pong ih tuu thii thungah nup oh loe, thok ranui hoi thok tung ranui boih ah nok oh; khawnbang khoek to mi doeh thok tasa bangah caeh o hmah.
Angraeng loe Izip kaminawk hum hanah Izip prae thung boih ah caeh tih; thok ranuih hoi thok tung ranuih boih ah nok ih athii to a hnuk naah, Angraeng mah to im thok to takan taak tih, to tiah kami humkung loe nangcae hum hanah imthung ah akunsak mak ai.
Sakzong ih atawk baktih toengah, hae hmuen hae nangmacae hoi na caanawk mah doeh pazui o poe ah.
Angraeng mah lokkam ih baktih toengah, anih mah paek han thuih ih prae thungah na kun o naah, hae tok hae sah o poe ah.
Na caanawk mah, Hae tok loe tih thuih koehhaih ih maw? tiah na dueng o nahaeloe,
nangcae mah nihcae khaeah, Hae loe Angraeng mah Izip kaminawk to hum moe, kaicae ih im loe pathlung, Izip prae ih Israel kaminawk ih im takan taakhaih, Angraeng ih loihhaih poih ah oh, tiah thui pae oh, tiah a naa. To pacoengah kaminawk mah akuep hoiah bok o.
Angraeng mah Mosi hoi Aaron khaeah thuih ih lok baktih toengah, Israel kaminawk mah sak o.
Aqum naah Angraeng mah Izip prae ih caa lu boih, angraeng tangkhang nuiah anghnu, Faro caa lu hoi kamtong thongkrah kami ih caa lu, tapen tangsuek moinawk to dueksak boih.
Faro, anih ih tamnanawk hoi Izip kaminawk loe qum ah angthawk o boih, Izip prae thungah qahhaih to oh; kadueh ai kami im roe maeto doeh om ai.
Aqum ah Faro mah Mosi hoi Aaron to kawk, Angthawk hoih! Nangmah hnik hoi Israel kaminawk to angthawk oh loe, kai kaminawk khae hoiah caeh o lai ah! Nang hnik hoi ih baktih toengah, Angraeng to bok oh.
Nangmacae ih tuunawk hoi maitawnawk doeh la oh loe, na thuih o ih baktih toengah caeh oh! Kai doeh tahamhoihaih na paek o toengah, tiah a naa.
Izip kaminawk mah, Kaicae loe kadueh kami ah ni ka oh o boih boeh, tiah a thuih o pongah, Israel kaminawk to Izip prae thung hoi karangah haek hanah, kaminawk to karangah pahruek o.
To pongah kaminawk mah taeh thuh ai ih takaw kahaeng to lak o moe, takaw naephaih boengloengnawk doeh kahni hoiah tapawk o pacoengah, palaeng ah aput o.
Mosi mah thuih ih lok baktih toengah, Israel kaminawk mah sak o; Izip kaminawk khaeah sui, sum kanglungnawk hoi khukbuennawk to a hnik o;
Angraeng mah Izip kaminawk khaeah tahmenhaih palungthin to paek pongah, nihcae mah hnik ih hmuen boih to a paek o. Nihcae mah Izip kaminawk ih hmuen to lak pae o.
Israel kaminawk loe Rameses hoi Sukkoth ah caeh o; to ah caeh kaminawk loe nongpata hoi nawkta thui ai ah, kami sang cumvai tarukto oh o.
Congca kaminawk loe tuunawk, maitawnawk, paroeai pop moinawk hoi nawnto caeh o.
Izip prae hoi sin o ih, taeh thuh ai ih takaw to lak o moe, taeh thuh ai ih takaw to hmai paop o; nihcae to Izip prae thung hoi karangah haek o, angmacae caak han mataeng doeh sak patok o pongah, takaw to taeh thuh ai ah a sin o.
Israel kaminawk loe Izip prae thungah saning cumvai pali, qui thumto oh o.
Angraeng ih misatuh kaminawk loe saning cumvai pali, qui thumto boeng na niah, Izip prae thung hoiah tacawt o.
Aqum ah Izip prae thung hoi caeh haih hanah, Angraeng mah nihcae to toep pongah, to aqum loe Israel caanawk boih mah zah han koi Angraeng ih aqum ah oh.
Angraeng mah Mosi hoi Aaron khaeah, Hae loe loihhaih poih sakhaih atawk ah oh; to pongah kawbaktih angvin mah doeh caa thai mak ai.
Toe misong ah na qan ih kami loe, tangzat hin aah pacoengah ni, caa tih.
Prae kalah kami, toksak han na tlai ih kaminawk loe caa o thai mak ai.
Im maeto ah caa oh; moi to im tasa bangah sin o hmah; ahuh doeh angkhaek o sak hmah.
Israel kaminawk boih mah to poih to sah oh.
Nangcae thung kaom angvin mah Angraeng loihhaih poih to sak koeh nahaeloe, a imthung takoh ih nongpanawk boih tangzat hin aat o nasoe; to pacoengah ni prae kaminawk baktiah sah o thai tih; tangzat hin aat ai kami loe mi doeh caa thai mak ai.
Prae thung tapen kami hoi nangcae salakah kaom prae kalah kami hanah, kanghmong daan maeto patoh oh, tiah a naa.
Angraeng mah Mosi hoi Aaron khaeah thuih ih lok baktih toengah, Israel kaminawk boih mah sak o.

caa lu boih kai khaeah ciimcai o sak ah; Israel kaminawk ih zok thung hoi tapen tangsuek loe, kami doeh, moi doeh, kai ih ni, tiah a naa.
To naah Mosi mah kaminawk khaeah, Angraeng mah a ban thacakhaih hoiah to prae thung hoi ang zaeh o pongah, misong ah na oh o haih Izip prae thung hoi na tacawt o haih ni, hae ni hae pakuem o poe ah; taeh thuh ih takaw to caa o hmah.
Vaihni Abib khrah thungah, na caeh o tih boeh.
Angraeng mah nangcae paek hanah nam panawk khaeah lokkam ih, tahnutui hoi khoitui longhaih Kanaan, Hit, Amor, Hiv hoi Jebus kaminawk ih prae thungah ang caeh o haih naah, hae khrah ah hae tiah toksak hanah pahnet o hmah.
Ni sarihto thung taeh thuh ai ih takaw to caa oh loe, ni sarihto naah Angraeng khaeah hae poih hae sah oh.
Ni sarihto thung taeh thuh ai ih takaw to caa oh; nangcae salakah taeh thuh ih takaw tidoeh suem o hmah; na oh o haih a taengah doeh taeh hoi sak ih takaw to amtueng o sak hmah.
To na niah na capa khaeah, Kaicae Izip prae thung hoi ka tacawt o naah, Angraeng mah tahmenhaih hoi kaicae nuiah hmuen to sak pongah, hae baktih hmuen hae ka sak o, tiah thui pae oh.
Hae hmuen loe nangcae ban ah angmathaih ah om tih, na mik salak ih lupataeh ah panoeksakkung ah om ueloe, na pakha ah Angraeng ih kaalok to om tih; Angraeng mah a thacakhaih rang hoiah Izip prae thung hoiah ang zaeh o.
Saningto pacoeng saningto, hae tue phak khruek, hae sakzong ih atawk hae sah oh.
Angraeng mah nangcae hoi nam panawk khaeah sak ih lokkamhaih baktih toengah, Kanaan prae ah ang caeh o haih moe, prae ang paek o naah,
zok thung hoi tapen tangsuek caa to Angraeng han pahoe oh; na tawnh ih tapen tangsuek moi doeh, ataenawk loe Angraeng ih ni.
Tapen tangsuek laa hrang to tuucaa hoiah akrang oh; akrang koeh o ai nahaeloe, laa hrang ih tahnong to khaek oh; na caanawk thungah caa lu to akrang oh.
Hmabang ah na caanawk mah, Hae hmuen loe tih thuih koehhaih ih maw? tiah na dueng o nahaeloe, Misong ah ohhaih Izip prae thung hoiah Angraeng mah a ban thacakhaih hoiah zaehhaih niah oh;
Faro mah aicae tacawtsak han koeh ai naah, Angraeng mah Izip prae thung ih caa lu boih, tapen tangsuek moi to dueksak boih; to pongah zok thung hoi tapen tangsuek moi boih Angraeng khaeah ka paek moe, caalunawk to ka krang, tiah thui pae oh, tiah a naa.
Angraeng mah a ban thacakhaih rang hoiah Izip prae thung hoi zaeh pongah, hae loe na ban hoi na mik salak ih lupataeh ah, angmathaih ah om tih, tiah a naa.
Faro mah kaminawk caehsak naah, Philistin prae caehhaih loklam loe anghnaih kue, toe to loklam hoiah Angraeng mah nihcae to caeh haih ai; Angraeng mah kaminawk misatukhaih tongh o naah, poekhaih amkhraih o ueloe, Izip prae ah amlaem o let moeng tih, tiah thuih.
To pongah Sithaw mah kaminawk to tuipui kathim caehhaih praezaek loklam bang hoiah caeh haih lat; Israel kaminawk loe misatukhaih khukbuen angkhukhaih hoiah ni Izip prae thung hoiah tacawt o.
Joseph mah Israel caanawk khaeah, Nangcae abomh hanah Sithaw angzo tih; to naah kai ih ahuh to hae ahmuen hoiah la o let ah, tiah lokkam baktih toengah, Mosi mah Joseph ih ahuh to laksak.
Nihcae leo Sukkoth hoi caeh o moe, praezaek taeng, Etham vangpui ah atai o.
Angraeng mah nihcae to khodai ah tamai hoiah zaeh moe, nihcae aanghaih paek hanah, khoving ah hmaithaw hoiah zaeh.
Khodai naah tamai tung, khoving naah hmaithaw hoiah kaminawk to hmabang ah a caeh haih.
Angraengh mah Mosi khaeah,
Israel kaminawk khaeah, Migdol vangpui hoi tuipui salak, Baal-Zephon vangpui taeng, tuipui taeng Pi-Hahiroth ah amlaem oh loe, tuipui taengah atai o han, thui paeh.
Faro mah Israel kaminawk kawng pongah, Nihcae loe saoeng ah raihaih tongh o, praezaek mah pakaa khoep boeh, tiah thui tih.
Faro to palung ka thahsak moe, nihcae ka patomsak let han; toe Faro hoi anih ih misatuh kaminawk nuiah, ka lensawkhaih to kam tuengsak han; to naah Izip kaminawk mah kai loe Angraeng ah ka oh, tito panoek o tih, tiah a naa. To pongah Israel kaminawk mah to tiah sak o.
Kaminawk cawnh o boih boeh, tiah Izip siangpahrang khaeah thuih pae o naah, Faro hoi a tamnanawk loe uthaih palungthin to tawnh o moe, kaminawk khaeah, Tikhoe hae tiah na sak o moe, aicae han toksah Israel kaminawk to na tacawt o sak boih loe? tiah a naa o.
To pongah angmah ih hrang leeng to suek coek moe, angmah ih kaminawk to nawnto a caeh haih;
kahoih koek hrang leeng cumvai tarukto a lak moe, Izip prae ih hrang angthueng kaminawk, misatuh angraengnawk to a kawk.
Angraeng mah Izip siangpahrang, Faro ih palung to thahsak pongah, anih mah Israel kaminawk to patom; toe Israel kaminawk loe amoekhaih hoiah caeh o.
Izip kaminawk, Faro ih hrangnawk hoi hrang leengnawk, hrang angthueng kaminawk hoi misatuh kaminawk mah Israel kaminawk to patom o moe, Bal-Zephon hmaa ih, vapui taeng Pi-Hariroth ah anghak o naah a kae o.
Israel kaminawk mah doeng o naah, Faro loe anghnai daek ah phak boeh; to naah Izip kaminawk mah nihcae patom boeh, tito panoek o, Israel kaminawk loe paroeai zit o moe, Angraeng khaeah hangh o.
Israel caanawk mah Mosi khaeah, Izip prae ah taprong om ai pongah maw, duek hanah praezaek ah nang caeh haih? Tipongah hae tiah sak hanah, Izip prae thung hoi nang caeh haih loe?
Izip prae ah, Na caeh o taak ah, kaicae loe Izip kaminawk ih tok to ka sak pae o halat han boeh, tiah kang thuih o na ai maw? Praezaek ah ka duek o pongah loe, Izip kaminawk ih toksak to kaicae han hoih kue, tiah a naa o.
Mosi mah kaminawk khaeah, Zii o hmah, kacakah angdoe oh, vaihni ah Angraeng mah nangcae hnuksak han ih, pahlonghaih to khen oh; vaihni ah na hnuk o ih Izip kaminawk loe, dungzan khoek to na hnu o let mak ai boeh.
Nangcae loe anghngai o duem ah, Angraeng mah nangcae han misa na tuh pae tih, tiah a naa.
To pacoengah Angraeng mah Mosi khaeah, Tipongah kai khaeah na hang o loe? Israel kaminawk khaeah hmabang caeh o poe hanah thui pae oh;
toe na cunghet to phok tahang ah, tuipui nuiah na ban to payang ah loe, tuipui to pakhoih ah; to naah Israel kaminawk loe tuipui um li ah saoeng baktiah caeh o tih.
Khenah, nihcae mah nangcae patom o hanah, Izip kaminawk to palung ka thahsak han; Faro hoi angmah ih misatuh kaminawk, hrang leengnawk hoi hrang angthueng kaminawk boih nuiah, ka lensawkhaih to amtueng tih.
Faro hoi angmah ih hrang leeng, anih ih hrang angthueng kaminawk nuiah ka lensawkhaih to kam tuengsak naah, Kai loe Angraeng ah ka oh, tito Izip kaminawk mah panoek o tih, tiah a naa.
Israel misatuh kaminawk ataihaih hmaa ah kacaeh, Sithaw ih van kami loe amlaem moe, nihcae hnuk ah a caeh; nihcae hmaa ah kacaeh tamai tung doeh nihcae hnukbang ah angdoet sut;
Izip misatuh kaminawk ataihaih ahmuen hoi Israel kaminawk ataihaih ahmuen salakah a caeh; tamai loe maeto hanah vinghaih ah oh moe, maeto hanah loe aanghaih ah oh pongah, nihcae loe aqum puek maeto hoi maeto khaeah caeh o thai ai.
To pacoengah Mosi mah tuipui bangah ban to payangh, to naah Angraeng mah aqum puek ni angyae bang hoiah takhi kaham to songsak, tui to saoeng ah angcoengsak moe, tui to hnetto ah amkhoih.
Israel kaminawk loe tuipui um li ah, saoeng ih lam caeh baktih toengah a caeh o; tui loe banqoi bantang im tapang baktiah oh.
Izip kaminawk loe Faro ih hrang, hrang leeng, hrang angthueng kaminawk hoiah nihcae to patom o moe, tuipui um li ah a caeh o.
Akhawnbang ah loe Angraeng mah tamai hmai thung hoiah Izip misatuh kaminawk to khet tathuk, to naah Izip misatuh kaminawk to raihaih paek.
Hrang leeng caeh thaih han ai ah, hrang leeng khoknawk to angmongsak boih; to naah Izip kaminawk mah, Israel kaminawk khae hoi cawn o ving si boeh; Angraeng mah hae kaminawk hanah Izip kaminawk to misa tuk pae boeh, tiah a thuih o.
To naah Angraeng mah Mosi khaeah, Izip kaminawk, hrang leengnawk hoi hrang angthueng kaminawk nuiah, tui angcuu let moe, khuk hmoek hanah, tuipui nuiah na ban to payangh ah, tiah a naa.
Mosi mah tuipui nuiah a ban to payangh; akhawnbang ah loe tuipui kathuk ah tui to angcuu let; Izip kaminawk loe cawnh o; toe Angraeng mah Izip kaminawk to tuipui um ah uemsak king.
Tui loe angcuu let moe, Nihcae patom Faro ih misatuh kaminawk, hrang leengnawk hoi hrang angthueng kaminawk to uem boih; kami maeto doeh anghmat o ai.
Toe Israel kaminawk loe tuipui um li ah saoeng baktiah caeh o poe; tui loe nihcae han banqoi bantang im tapang baktiah oh.
To na niah Angraeng mah Israel kaminawk to Izip kaminawk ih ban thung hoiah pahlong; tuipui taengah kadueh Izip kaminawk ih qok to Israel kaminawk mah hnuk o.
Izip kaminawk nuiah Angraeng mah kalen parai toksakhaih to amtuengsak, tito Israel kaminawk mah hnuk o naah, Angraeng to zit o moe, Angraeng hoi a tamna Mosi nuiah tanghaih to tawnh o.
To pacoengah Mosi hoi Israel kaminawk mah Angraeng khaeah hae laa hae a sak o; Angraeng mah lensawkhaih hoiah pazawk boeh pongah, anih khaeah laa to ka sak han; anih mah hrang hoi a nuiah angthueng kaminawk tui thungah vah boih boeh.
Agraeng loe ka thacakhaih hoi kai ih laa ah oh moe, kai pahlonghaih ah oh; anih loe ka Sithaw ah oh pongah, anih to ka pakoeh han; kam pa ih Sithaw ah oh pongah, ka pakoeh han.
Angraeng loe misatuh kami ah oh, anih ih ahmin loe Angraeng, tiah oh.
Anih mah Faro ih hrang leeng hoi misatuh kaminawk to tui thungah vah boih boeh; Faro mah kahoih koek qoih ih misatuh angraengnawk loe kathim tuipui thungah uem o boih boeh.
Kathuk tuili mah nihcae to khuk khoep, nihcae loe thlung baktiah tui thungah krak o tathuk boeh.
Aw Angraeng, thacak na bantang ban hoiah na misanawk to kadip pueng ah na hnoih.
Na lensawk na thacakhaih hoiah na misanawk to na vah phaeng, nihcae to na palungphuihaih mah anghnoeng baktiah kangh boeh.
Na hnahkhaw ih takhi hoiah tuinawk to nang cuusak; tuiphu to im tapang baktiah nang doetsak moe, kathuk tuipui um li ah tui to tha na caksak.
Misanawk mah, nihcae kae hanah, ka patom o moe, lomh ih hmuennawk to kam zet o han, to naah loe ka koehhaih akoep tih boeh; ka sumsen to ka phongh moe, nihcae to ka ban hoiah ka hum han, tiah a thuih o.
Toe nang hahhaih takhi hoiah na hmuh, nihcae loe tuipui mah khuk khoep; nihcae loe kalen parai tuinawk thungah, kimlok baktiah krak o zuep boeh.
Aw Angraeng, sithawnawk thungah mi maw nang baktiah kaom? Mi maw nang baktiah, lensawk ciimcaihaih, zit kathok pakoehhaih hoiah dawnrai hmuennawk to sah thaih?
Na bantang ban na payangh naah, long mah nihcae to paaeh.
Kaboeng thai ai na palung nathaih hoiah na krang ih kaminawk to na zaeh; na thacakhaih hoiah na ohhaih hmuenciim to nihcae hanah na patuek.
Kaminawk mah thaih o naah, zii o tih; Philistin kaminawk loe tasoehhaih hoiah om o tih.
Edom ukkungnawk loe dawnrai o ueloe, Moab zaehoikungnawk doeh tasoeh o tih; Kanaan kaminawk loe palungboeng o tih.
Zithaih hoi tasoehhaih to nihcae nuiah krah tih; Aw Angraeng, nangmah ih kaminawk to poeng o moe, na qan ih kaminawk poeng o pacoengah, kalensawk na ban thacakhaih rang hoiah nihcae to thlung baktiah angtawt ai ah nang hngaisak duem tih.
Aw Angraeng, qawk ah na toep ih mae, oh hanah na sak ih ahmuen thungah, nangmah ih kaminawk to na kun haih tih; Aw Angraeng, na ban hoi sak ih hmuenciim ah nihcae to na omsak tih.
Angraeng mah dungzan hoi dungzan khoek to uk poe tih, tiah laa to a sak o.
Faro ih hrangnawk, hrang leengnawk hoi hrang angthueng kaminawk loe, tuipui thungah caeh o pacoengah, Angraeng mah nihcae nuiah tuipui to amlaemsak let; toe Israel kaminawk loe tuipui um li ah saoeng baktiah caeh o.
To naah Aaron ih tanuh, tahmaa nongpata Miriam mah, cingceng to ban ah sin moe, nongpatanawk boih anih hnuk ah cingceng bohhaih hoiah hnawh o.
Miriam mah, Angraeng khaeah laa to sah oh; anih mah lensawkhaih hoiah pazawk boeh; hrang hoi a nuiah angthueng kaminawk to tuipui thungah a vah boih boeh, tiah laa to sak.
Mosi mah Israel kaminawk tuipui kathim hoiah zaeh moe, Shur praezaek ah a caeh haih; ni thumto thung tui om ai ah, praezaek ah a caeh o.
Marah ahmuen to a phak o naah, tui loe khaa pongah, Marah ih tui to nae o thai ai; to pongah to ahmuen to Marah, tiah kawk o.
To pongah kaminawk mah Mosi khaeah, Timaw ka naek o han? tiah laisaep o thuih.
To naah Mosi mah Angraeng khaeah hangh, to naah Angraeng mah thing maeto a hnuksak; anih mah to thing to tui thungah vah naah, tui to luep; to ahmuen ah Anih mah nihcae to tanoek, a sak o zong ih hmuen hoi daan to a sak pae.
Nihcae khaeah, Na Angraeng Sithaw ih lok kahoih ah na tahngaih o, a mikhnuk ah katoeng hmuen to na sak o moe, ang paek o ih lok to na tahngaih o pacoengah, anih ih daannawk to na pazui o nahaeloe, Izip kaminawk nuiah ka phaksak ih nathaih to, nangcae nuiah ka phasak mak ai; Kai loe nangcae ngantuisakkung, Angraeng ah ka oh, tiah a naa.
Nihcae loe tui khaw hathlai hnetto hoi ungsikung qui sarihto ohhaih, Elim ahmuen ah caeh o moe, tui taengah anghak o.
Israel kaminawk boih, Elim ahmuen hoiah angthawk o moe, Elim hoi Sinai salakah kaom, Sin praezaek ah a caeh o; Izip prae hoi tacawthaih khrah hnetto haih ni hatlai pangato naah to ahmuen to a phak o.
Praezaek ah kaminawk boih mah Mosi hoi Aaron to laisaep o thuih.
Israel kaminawk mah nihnik khaeah, Izip prae ah moi thonghaih laom taengah anghnut moe, zok kamhah ah ka caak o naah, Angraeng ih ban hoi ka duek o nahaeloe hoih kue han to mah! Nanghnik mah haeah amkhueng kaminawk hae zok kamtlam ah dueksak hanah, hae praezaek ah na hoih hoi, tiah a naa o.
To naah Angraeng mah Mosi khaeah, Khenah, nangcae han van hoiah takaw kho baktiah kang zohsak han; kaminawk to caeh o nasoe loe, nito caak kakhawt ah takaw to akhui o nasoe; ka paek ih lok tahngai o maw, tahngai o ai, tito hae tiah ka tanoek han.
Ni tarukto naah loe, ni kalah ah akhuih ih pongah kamtlai alet hnetto ah akhui o nasoe loe, suem o nasoe, tiah a naa.
To pongah Mosi hoi Aaron mah Israel kaminawk boih khaeah, Izip prae thung hoi nangcae zaehoikung loe Angraeng ni, tito vai duem ah na panoek o tih;
akhawnbang ah doeh Angraeng lensawkhaih to na hnu o tih; na laisaep o haih to Angraeng mah thaih boeh; kaihnik loe kawbang maw ka oh hoi moe, nang laisaep o thuih? tiah a naa hoi.
Mosi mah, Angraeng mah caak han ih moi to duembang ah na paek o ueloe, akhawnbang ah zok amhah hanah takaw to na paek o tih; to naah, Na laisaep o haih lok Angraeng mah thaih boeh, tiah thuih ih lok to akoep tih; kaihnik loe kawbang maw ka oh hoi moe, nang laisaep o thuih? Laisaep kaminawk loe kaihnik laisaep thuih ai ah, Angraeng ni na laisaep o thuih, tiah a naa hoi.
To naah Mosi mah Aaron khaeah, Na laisaep o haih lok to Angraeng mah thaih boeh pongah, anih khaeah angzo oh, tiah thuih pae han a naa.
Aaron mah amkhueng Israel kaminawk boih khaeah lok to thuih pae, nihcae praezaek bangah doeng o naah, tamai nuiah Angraeng lensawkhaih to amtueng.
Angraeng mah Mosi khaeah,
Israel kaminawk laisaephaih lok to ka thaih boeh; nihcae khaeah, Duembang ah moi to na caa o ueloe, akhawnbang ah takaw to zok kamhah ah na caa o tih; to naah kai loe nangcae ih Angraeng Sithaw ah ka oh, tito na panoek o tih, tiah thui paeh, tiah a naa.
To na ni duembang ah kuikoemnawk loe nihcae ohhaih ahmuen taeng koimong ah angzoh o tahang; akhawnbang ah loe misatuh kaminawk ataihaih ahmuen taengah dantui to krak.
Dantui anghmat pacoengah, khenah, praezaek ih long nui ah, dantui baktih kangbuet luet tetta kaom, hmuen to oh.
To hmuen to Israel kaminawk mah hnuk o naah, hae loe manna maw? tiah maeto hoi maeto a thuih o. To hmuen loe timaw, tito panoek o ai. Mosi mah nihcae khaeah, Hae loe na caak o hanah Angraeng mah paek ih takaw ni.
Angraeng mah, Kami boih mah caak kakhawt ah akhui oh; kahni im ah kaom a caanawk caak khawt ah, kami maeto mah omer maeto akhui o hanah a thuih pae.
A thuih ih lok baktih toengah Israel kaminawk mah sak o; thoemto kaminawk loe kapop ah akhuih o, thoemto kaminawk mah loe zetta ah akhuih o.
To tiah akhui o ih manna to omer hoi tah o naah, kapop ah akhui kami doeh amtlai ai; zetta akhui kami doeh vawt ai; kami boih mah caak khawt ah akhuih o.
To naah Mosi mah nihcae khaeah, Mi kawbaktih doeh akhawnbang khoek to amtlai o sak hmah, tiah a naa.
Toe thoemto kaminawk mah Mosi mah thuih ih lok to tahngai o ai; akhawnbang khoek to a suek o; toe qong moe, ahmui set pae; to pongah Mosi loe nihcae nuiah palungphui.
Akhawnbang kruek kami boih mah angmacae caak khawt ah akhui o; ni bet naah loe, amkaw boih.
Ni tarukto naah loe kaminawk mah takaw baktiah alet hnetto kamtlai ah akhui o; kami maeto hanah omer hnetto akhuih o; rangpui ukkungnawk loe caeh o moe, to hmuen to Mosi khaeah thuih pae o.
Mosi mah nihcae khaeah, Angraeng mah, khawnbang loe kaciim Angraeng anghakhaih ni, Sabbath ah oh, to pongah hmai paaem koi hmuen to hmai paaem oh ah loe, bueh koi to buet o coek ah; kamtlai to akhawnbang khoek to kahoih ah pakuem oh, tiah a thuih, tiah a naa.
To pongah Mosi mah thuih ih lok baktih toengah, akhawnbang caak hanah a suek o; toe hmuisae ai, qong doeh qong ai.
Mosi mah nihcae khaeah, to takaw to vaihniah caa oh; vaihni loe Angraeng ih Sabbath ah oh pongah, to hmuen to long ah na hnu o mak ai.
Ni tarukto naah akhui oh loe patung oh; toe ni sarihto Sabbath niah loe maeto doeh na hnu o mak ai, tiah a naa.
Toe thoemto kaminawk loe akhuih han caeh o nganga; toe maeto doeh hnu o ai.
To naah Angraeng mah Mosi khaeah, Nangcae mah nasetto maw kang paek o ih lok hoi kai ih kaalok to na aek o han vop?
Angraeng mah Sabbath to ang paek o; to pongah ni tarukto ni ah ni hnetto caak hanah takaw to ang paek o; kami boih ni sarihto naah loe angmah ohhaih ahmuen ah om o boih nasoe loe, mi doeh a ohhaih ahmuen hoi tasa bangah tacawt hmah nasoe, tiah a naa.
To pongah kaminawk loe ni sarihto naah anghak o.
Israel kaminawk mah to ih takaw to manna, tiah kawk o; to takaw loe coriander amu baktiah oh, anglung moe, khoitui hoi sak ih takaw baktiah luep.
Mosi mah Angraeng mah paek ih lok loe hae tiah oh; Izip prae thung hoiah kang zaeh o naah, praezaek ah kang pacah o ih takaw to angzo han koi na caanawk mah hnuk o thai hanah, manna to omer maeto kakoi ah suem oh, tiah a thuih, tiah a naa.
To pongah Mosi mah Aaron khaeah, Boengloeng maeto la ah loe, to thungah manna omer maeto kakoi ah thaeng ah; na caanawk han pakuem pae hanah, Angraeng hmaa ah suem ah, tiah a naa.
Angraeng mah Mosi khaeah thuih ih lok baktih toengah pakuem hanah, hnukung hmaa ah Aaron mah thaengh.
Anghakhaih prae pha o ai karoek to Israel kaminawk mah saning qui palito thung manna to caak o; Kanaan prae phak khoek to manna to a caak o.
Ephah hato thungah maeto loe omer maeto ah oh.
Israel kaminawk loe Angraeng mah thuih ih lok baktih toengah, Sin praezaek hoi tacawt o moe, ahmuen kalah bangah kholong caeh o; Rephidim ahmuen ah anghak o; to ahmuen ah loe kaminawk mah naek o hanah tui to om ai.
Topongah kaminawk mah, Ka naek o hanah tui na paek ah, tiah Mosi to zoeh o. Mosi mah nihcae khaeah, Tikhoe kai nang zoeh o moe, Angraeng to na tanoek o loe? tiah a naa.
Toe kaminawk loe tui anghaeh o boeh pongah, Mosi to laisaep o thuih; nihcae mah, Tipongah kaimah hoi ka caanawk khue ai ah, ka tawnh o ih moinawk doeh duek hanah, Izip prae thung hoi hae praezaek ah nang caeh haih loe? tiah a naa o.
To naah Mosi mah Angraeng khaeah, Hae kaminawk hae kawbang maw ka naa han? Kai thlung hoi ang vah o tom boeh, tiah a hang.
To naah Angraeng mah Mosi khaeah, Kaminawk hmaa ah caeh ah, Israel kacoehtanawk hoi nawnto caeh ah, tuipui na bohhaih cunghet to sin ah loe, caeh ah.
Khenah, Na hmaa ih Horeb lungsong nuiah kang doet han; lungsong to bop ah, kaminawk mah naek o hanah, lungsong thung hoiah tui to tacawt tih, tiah a naa. Mosi mah to tiah Israel kaminawk mikhnuk ah sak.
Israel kaminawk mah, Aicae salakah Angraeng oh maw, om ai? tiah Angraeng to tanoek o moe, zoeh o pongah, to ahmuen to Massah hoi Meribah, tiah ahmin paek o.
Amalek kaminawk loe angzoh o moe, Rephidim ahmuen ah Israel kaminawk hoiah angtuk o.
Mosi mah Joshua khaeah, Aicae thung hoi thoemto kaminawk to qoi ah loe, Amalek misatuk hanah caeh ah; khawnbang ah Sithaw ih cunghet to ban ah ka sin moe, mae nuiah kang doet han, tiah a naa.
To pongah Mosi mah thuih ih lok baktih toengah, Joshua mah Amalek kaminawk to tuk; to naah Mosi, Aaron hoi Hur loe mae nuiah dawh o.
Mosi ban payangh naah, Israel kaminawk mah misa pazawk o; toe anih ih ban pakhrak tathuk naah, Amalek kaminawk mah pazawk o.
Mosi ban khah naah thlung to lak o moe, anih tlim ah suek pae o; anih to thlung nuiah anghnut o sak pacoengah, Aaron hoi Hur mah anih ih ban to hae bang hoi ho bang, niduem khoek to, pakhrah ai ah atoengh pae hoi.
To pongah Joshua mah Amalek misa to sumsen hoiah tuk pazawk.
To naah Angraeng mah Mosi khaeah, Hae hmuen hae panoek poe hanah cabu pongah tarik ah loe, Joshua han kahoih ah kroek paeh; Amalek kaminawk poekhaih loe van tlim hoiah kang hmatsak han, tiah a naa.
Mosi mah hmaicam maeto sak moe, Jehovah-nissi, tiah ahmin paek.
Mosi mah, A caanawk adung maeto pacoeng maeto khoek to Angraeng mah Amalek kaminawk to tuh tih, tiah Angraeng mah lokkam boeh, tiah thuih.
Sithaw mah Mosi hoi Angraeng ih Israel kaminawk han sak pae ih hmuennawk boih hoi kawbang maw Angraeng mah Israel kaminawk Izip prae thung hoiah zaeh, tiah Mosi ih amsae, Midian kami qaima Jethro mah thaih naah,
Jethro loe Mosi mah patoeh let ih a zu Zipporah hoi,
a capa hnik to lak let; Mosi mah minawk prae ah angvin ah ka oh, tiah poek pongah, maeto loe Gershom, tiah ahmin paek;
kam pa ih Sithaw loe kai bomkung ah oh, anih mah Faro ih sumsen thung hoiah ang pahlong, tiah a thuih pongah, a capa kalah maeto loe Eliezer, tiah ahmin sak.
Mosi ih amsae Jethro loe Mosi ih zu, capa hnik hoi nawnto Mosi anghakhaih Sithaw mae taeng ih praezaek ah caeh o;
to naah Jethro mah, Nam sae, kai, Jethro loe na zu, na capa hnik hoi nawnto nang khaeah kang zoh o boeh, tiah a naa.
To pongah Mosi mah amsae to hnuk hanah a dawt, akuep moe, anih to mok; loklang angdueng o pacoengah, kahni imthung ah akun o.
Mosi mah amsae khaeah, Angraeng mah Israel kaminawk hanah, Faro hoi Izip kaminawk nuiah sak pae ih hmuennawk boih, loklam ah a tongh o ih raihaihnawk hoi Angraeng mah Israel kaminawk kawbang maw pahlong, tito a thuih pae boih.
Jethro loe Angraeng mah Israel kaminawk nuiah sak ih kahoih hmuennawk boih hoi nihcae to Izip kaminawk ih ban thung hoi pahlong pongah anghoehaih a tawnh.
Anih mah, Izip kaminawk hoi Faro ih ban thung hoiah pahlongkung, Izip kaminawk ih ban thung hoi pahlongkung, Angraeng loe tahamhoihaih om nasoe.
Angraeng loe kalah sithawnawk boih pongah len kue, tito ka panoek boeh; kaminawk amoekhaih loe anih mah pazawk boeh, tiah a naa.
To pacoengah Mosi amsae Jethro mah hmai angbawnhaih sak hanah moi hoi kalah hmuennawk to Sithaw khaeah sinh; to naah Aaron hoi Israel kacoehtanawk loe Mosi amsae hoi nawnto Sithaw hmaa ah takaw caak hanah angzoh o.
Mosi loe kaminawk lokcaek hanah akhawnbang ah anghnut; kaminawk loe akhawnbang hoi duembang khoek to Mosi taengah angdoet o.
Mosi mah kaminawk nuiah sak ih hmuen to amsae mah hnuk naah, kawbang maw kaminawk nuiah hae tiah hmuen hae na sak? Tikhoe kaminawk loe akhawnbang hoi duembang khoek to na taengah anghnut o moe, nangmah bueng lok na caek loe? tiah a naa.
Mosi mah Sithaw koehhaih pakrong han ih ni kai khaeah angzoh o;
lok angaekhaih oh naah, kai khaeah angzoh o; kai mah nihcae to maeto pacoeng maeto lok ka caek moe, Sithaw zaehhoihhaih daan hoi loknawk to ka thuih pae, tiah a naa.
Mosi amsae mah anih khaeah, Na sak ih hmuen hae hoih ai.
Hae tok loe nang hanah azit hmoek pongah, nangmah hoi na taengah kaom kaminawk loe thazok o tangtang tih; nangmah bueng na pazawk thai mak ai.
Vaihi ka lok hae tahngai ah, poekhaih kang paek han; nang khaeah Sithaw om nasoe; nang loe Sithaw hmaa ah laicaeh ah om ah loe, lok angaekhaih Sithaw khaeah thuikung ah om ah;
kaminawk khaeah zaehhoihaih daan hoi kaaloknawk to patuk ah; nihcae caeh han koi loklam to patuek ah loe, nihcae mah sak han koi hmuen to thui paeh.
Kaminawk thung hoiah Sithaw zii kami, oepthok kami, kamtlai koeh hmoek ai kaminawk to qoih loe, sangto, cumvaito, qui pangato hoi pangato ukkungnawk to suem ah.
To kaminawk mah hmuen boih nuiah lokcaek o nasoe loe, karai hmuen khue to nang khaeah angzo o haih nasoe; toe kazoi hmuen loe nihcae mah lokcaek o nasoe; to tiah na sak nahaeloe nihcae mah na tok to lawnh o ueloe, na phawh ih hmuen doeh anghoep kue tih.
Sithaw mah paek ih lok baktih toengah, hae tiah na sak nahaeloe, kacakah nang doe thai ueloe, hae ih kaminawk boih doeh, lunghoihta hoiah angmacae im ah amlaem o tih, tiah a naa.
Mosi mah amsae ih lok to tahngaih moe, a thuih ih lok baktih toengah sak.
Mosi loe Israel kaminawk boih thung hoiah toksah thaih kaminawk to qoih moe, sangto ukkung, cumvaito ukkung, qui pangato ukkung, hato ukkung hoi pangato ukkung, tiah a suek boih.
Nihcae loe kawbaktih atue ah doeh lokcaek kami ah oh o; karai hmuen to Mosi khaeah caeh o haih moe, kazoi hmuen loe angmacae mah pathlaeng o.
To pacoengah Mosi mah amsae to amlaemsak let; Jethro loe angmah prae ah amlaem let.
Israel kaminawk Izip prae thung hoi tacawt o pacoeng, khrah thumto naah, Sinai praezaek to phak o.
Israel kaminawk loe Rephidim hoi amsak o moe, Sinai praezaek phak o pacoengah, mae hmaa ah atai o.
Mosi mah Sithaw khae caeh tahang naah, Angraeng angmah khaeah angzoh hanah mae nui hoiah a kawk moe, Jakob imthung takoh hoi Israel kaminawk khaeah hae tiah a thui paeh;
Izip kaminawk khaeah ka sak ih hmuen na hnuk o boeh; kawbang maw tahmu ih pakhraeh pongah kang hnut o sak moe, kaimah khaeah kang hoih o, tito na panoek o boeh.
To pongah vaihi ka lok hae na tahngaih o moe, ka lokkamhaih na aek o ai nahaeloe, nangcae loe kaminawk boih salakah kai ih qawk ah na om o tih; long pum loe kai ih ni;
nangcae loe kai han kaciim acaeng hoi siangpahrang ukhaih prae ah kai ih qaima ah na om o tih, tiah a thuih pae. Hae loknawk hae Israel kaminawk khaeah thui paeh, tiah a naa.
To pongah Mosi loe amlaem let moe, Israel kacoehtanawk to kawk pacoengah, Angraeng mah anih khaeah thuih ih loknawk to nihcae hmaa ah thuih pae boih.
Kaminawk mah, Angraeng mah thuih ih lok to ka sak o boih han, tiah nawnto a thuih o. Nihcae ih lok to Mosi mah Angraeng khaeah tathlangh pae let.
Angraeng mah Mosi khaeah, Khenah, nang hoi thuih ih lok kaminawk mah thaih o moe, nang to dungzan khoek to tang o thai hanah, tamai thung hoi nang khaeah kang zoh han, tiah a naa. Kaminawk mah thuih ih loknawk to Mosi mah Angraeng khaeah tathlangh pae.
To pacoengah Angraeng mah Mosi khaeah, Kaminawk khaeah caeh ah loe, nihcae to vaihni hoi khawnbang ah ciimcaisak ah; angmacae ih khukbuennawk to pasuk o nasoe loe,
ni thumto naah om o coek nasoe; ni thumto naah loe kaminawk boih hmaa ah, Sinai mae nuiah Angraeng to anghum tathuk tih.
Kaminawk mah mae sang to poeng o han ai ah sah paeh, mae sang nuiah daw o hmah, mae sang amtonghaih long doeh sui o hmah; mae sang to ban hoi sui kami loe paduek tangtang ah om tih.
Anih to ban hoi sui hmah, sui kami loe thlung hoi vah maat ai boeh loe, palaa hoi kah maat han oh; kami maw, to tih ai boeh loe moi maw hing o sak hmah, tiah a thuih, tiah thui paeh; atue kasawk ah mongkah ueng pacoengah ni, kaminawk to mae nuiah daw o vop tih, tiah a naa.
Mosi mae nui hoi kaminawk khaeah anghum tathuk pacoengah, kaminawk to amprik caisak; nihcae mah khukbuennawk to pasuk o.
To pacoengah kaminawk khaeah, Ni thumto hanah amsak o coek ah, na zunawk khaeah iip o hmah, tiah a naa.
Ni thumto akhawnbang ah loe, khopazih hoi tangphra to puek moe, kathah parai tamai mah mae to khuk khoep, mongkah lok loe tuen parai pongah, ataihaih im ah kaom kaminawk to tasoeh o boih.
To naah Mosi mah Sithaw tongh hanah, kaminawk to ataihaih im hoiah caeh haih, nihcae loe mae tlim ah angdoet o.
To naah Angraeng loe hmai thung hoiah angzoh pongah, Sinai mae to hmaikhue mah ayaw hmoek; takoeng hoi tacawt hmaikhue baktih toengah, mae to anghuenh boih.
Mongkah to kasawkah ueng naah, lok to len aep aep; Mosi mah lok to thuih, to naah Sithaw mah lok hoiah pathim pae.
Angraeng loe Sinai mae nuiah anghum tathuk moe, Mosi to mae nuiah kawk; to pongah Mosi loe dawh tahang.
Angraeng mah anih khaeah, Kaminawk loe Angraeng khet hanah caeh o nganga moe, a duek o han ai ah, anghum tathuk ah loe kaminawk to thuitaek ah.
Angraeng khaeah angzo qaima boih angmacae hoi angmacae to amprik cai o nasoe; to tih ai nahaeloe Angraeng mah nihcae to thuitaek moeng tih, tiah a naa.
Mosi mah Angraeng khaeah, Kaminawk mah mae to poeng o han ai ah angzithaih ramri to sah paeh loe, amprik caisak ah, tiah na thuih pongah, kaminawk Sinai mae nuiah angzo o thai ai, tiah a naa.
Angraeng mah caeh tathuk ah loe, Aaron to angzo haih ah; toe qaimanawk hoi kaminawk loe Angraeng khaeah angzo o nganga hmah nasoe; to tih ai nahaeloe nihcae to danpaekhaih tong o moeng tih, tiah a naa.
To pongah Mosi loe kaminawk khaeah anghum tathuk moe, lok to thuih pae.
Hae loknawk boih Sithaw mah thuih;
kai loe misong ah na ohhaih, Izip prae thung hoi nangcae zaehoikung, Angraeng Sithaw ah ka oh.
Ka hmaa ah Sithaw kalah tawn hmah.
Van ranui ah kaom krang maw, to tih ai boeh loe long tlim ah kaom krang maw, to tih ai boeh loe tui thungah kaom hmuen hoi kanghmong, kawbaktih krang doeh sah hmah;
nihcae hmaa ah akuep o hmah loe, bok o hmah; na Angraeng Sithaw, Kai loe ut panoek Sithaw ah ka oh moe, kai hnuma ampanawk ih zaehaih pongah, a caanawk adung thumto hoi palito karoek to thuitaekkung ah ka oh.
Toe kai palung moe, ka thuih ih lok pazui kaminawk loe a caanawk ih adung sangto pong kapop adung khoek to amlunghaih patuekkung ah ka oh.
Avang ai ah na Angraeng Sithaw ih ahmin to patoh hmah; anih ih ahmin tidoeh na ai ah patoh rumram kami loe, Angraeng mah anih to khen sut mak ai.
Sabbath ni to ciimsak hanah pakuem poe ah.
Ni tarukto thung toksah ah, na tok to sah boih ah.
Toe ni sarihto naah loe, na Angraeng Sithaw ih Sabbath niah oh; to niah loe tih tok doeh sah hmah; nangmah doeh, na capa doeh, na canu doeh, na tamna nongpa doeh, na tamna nongpata doeh, na tawnh ih moinawk hoi na khongkha thungah kaom angvin doeh toksak o han om ai;
Angraeng mah ni tarukto thung van hoi long, tuipui hoi a thungah kaom hmuennawk boih to sak moe, ni sarihto naah loe anghak; to pongah Angraeng mah Sabbath ni to tahamhoihaih paek moe, ciimcaisak.
Nam no hoi nam pa khingya ah; to tih nahaeloe Angraeng Sithaw mah paek ih, prae thungah hinglung na sawk tih.
Kami hum hmah.
Zu sava laep ah nongpa nongpata zaehaih sah hmah.
Paqu hmah.
Na imtaeng kami nuiah amsawn hnukung ah angdoe hmah.
Na imtaeng kami ih im to khit hmah; na imtaeng kami ih zu to khit hmah, to tih ai boeh loe anih ih tamna nongpa, to tih ai boeh loe anih ih tamna nongpata, anih ih maitaw doeh, anih ih laa hrang doeh, na imtaeng kami ih kawbaktih hmuen doeh khit hmah, tiah lok a paek.
Khopazih tuen, tangphrapuekhaih hoi mongkah lok to kaminawk mah thaih o, mae thung hoi tacawt hmaikhue to a hnuk o naah, angnawn o moe, kangthla ah angdoet o.
Mosi khaeah, Kaicae khae lok na thui ah, kang tahngaih pae o han; Sithaw mah kaicae khaeah lokthui hmah nasoe, ka dueh o moeng tih, tiah a naa o.
Mosi mah kaminawk khaeah, Zii o hmah; mikhmai ah anih zithaih na tawnh o moe, zaehaih na sak o han ai ah, nangcae tanoek han ih Sithaw angzoh tathuk boeh, tiah a naa.
Kaminawk loe kangthla ah angdoet o, toe Mosi loe Sithaw ohhaih kathah parai tamai kamnum ohhaih bangah a caeh.
To naah Angraeng mah Mosi khaeah, Israel kaminawk khaeah, Kai mah van hoiah kang thuih ih lok to na hnuk o boeh, tiah thui paeh, tiah a naa.
Kai nang bok o naah, nangmacae hanah sui sithaw doeh, sum kanglung sithaw doeh sah o hmah.
Kai hanah long hoiah hmaicam mae to sah ah loe, to long hmaicam nuiah hmai angbawnhaih, angdaeh angbawnhaih to tuu hoi maitaw taenawk hoiah sah ah; kai ih ahmin pakoehhaih ahmuen kruekah, nang khaeah kang zoh moe, tahamhoihaih kang paek han.
Kai hanah thlung hmaicam to na sak nahaeloe, thuk ih thlung kangphaek nuiah hmaicam to sah hmah; thlung kangphaek thukhaih sum to na phok tahang naah, hmaicam to nam hnongsak ah oh boeh.
Bangkrai ah na ohhaih amtueng han ai ah, hmaicam ranui ah dawhhaih thlak to sah hmah, tiah a naa.
Hae daan hae nihcae hmaa ah suem paeh;
Hebru kami to tamna ah na qan nahaeloe, anih mah saning tarukto thung na tok to sah tih; toe saning sarihto naah loe, atho tidoeh hni ai ah loihsak han oh.
Angmah bueng tamna ah om nahaeloe, angmah bueng loih han oh; to kami loe zu tawn nahaeloe, a zu hoi nawnto loih tih.
Angmah ih angraeng mah anih han zu to lak pae moe, caa nongpa maw, to tih ai boeh loe canu maw sah nahaeloe, anih ih caanawk loe angmah angraeng ih hmuen ah om tih; a tamna loe angmah bueng ah loih tih.
Toe a tamna mah, Ka Angraeng, ka zu hoi ka caanawk to palung pongah, tacawt han koeh ai, tiah thui nahaeloe,
angmah ih angraeng mah anih to lokcaekkungnawk hmaa ah caeh haih tih; anih mah khongkha, to tih ai boeh loe khongkha tung ohhaih ahmuen ah caeh haih ueloe, angmah ih angraeng mah a tamna ih naa to moihin aqawthaih phungvang hoiah aqawt pae tih, to tiah anih loe a hing thung angraeng ih tamna ah om tih.
Kami maeto mah a canu to tamna ah zaw nahaeloe, to nongpata to nongpa baktiah prawt sut han om ai.
Anih qankung angraeng mah to nongpata to zu ah lak han koeh ai nahaeloe, angmah hoi angmah to angkrangsak ah; angraeng mah to nongpata to aling pongah, kalah prae kami khaeah zaw thai mak ai.
To nongpata to a capa han paek nahaeloe, anih to a canu baktiah khet han oh.
Anih mah kalah nongpata to zu ah la let nahaeloe, hmaloe ih a zu nongpata ih caaknaek maw, to tih ai boeh loe sava sak nathuem ih khukbuen maw, khring pae han om ai.
Hae hmuen thumto sah ai nahaeloe, tangka paek angaih ai ah, nongpata to loih han oh.
Minawk hum kami loe, paduek han oh.
Pacaenghaih om ai ah, anih ban ah Sithaw mah to kami to paek nahaeloe, anih cawnhaih ahmuen ka suek pae han.
Toe pacaenghaih hoiah a imtaeng kami to hum nahaeloe, ka hmaicam ah abuep cadoeh anih loe duek han oh.
Amno hoi ampa hum kami loe, paduek han oh.
Kami paqu kami loe, kami to zawh maw, to tih ai boeh loe angmah ban ah maw suem cadoeh, paduek han oh.
Amno hoi ampa tangoeng kami loe paduek han oh.
Kami hnik loe angpan hoi moe, maeto mah kalah maeto thlung hoiah vah maw, to tih ai boeh loe ban pathluem moe a thong, toe to kami loe dueh ai, iihkhun nuiah angsong sut,
toe to kami loe angthawk moe, cunghet hoiah lam caeh thaih nahaeloe, anih bop kami to loihsak han oh; toe to kami loe ahmaa ca nahaeloe, ngantui ai ah a oh nathung, patoh ih kaboeng hmuennawk boih to laem tih.
Kami maeto mah a tamna nongpa maw, nongpata maw boh pongah dueh nahaeloe, anih to danpaek han oh.
Toe tamna to dueh ai moe, ni hnetto maw, ni thumto maw oh pacoengah angthawk let nahaeloe, a tamna loe anih ih phoisa ah oh pongah, bop kami to danpaek han om ai.
Nongpa hnik loe angpan hoi naah, zokpomh nongpata to nganbawh kana paek hoi moeng pongah, nawkta to khrah akoep ai ah zun moeng nahaeloe, nongpata ih sava mah thuih ih baktih toengah, danpaek han oh; lokcaekkung mah thuih ih baktih toengah paek tih.
Toe kalah ahmaa casak nahaeloe, hinghaih to hinghaih hoiah pathok han oh.
Mik pongah mik, haa pongah haa, ban pongah ban, khok pongah khok,
hmai hoi thlaek pongah hmai hoi thlaek, ahmaa caksak pongah ahmaa caksak, nganbawh kana paek pongah nganbawh kana paek han oh.
Kami maeto mah a tamna nongpa maw, nongpata maw mik ah boh pongah, mik amro nahaeloe, mik amrosak kami to danpaekhaih thung hoi loihsak han oh.
Kami maeto mah a tamna nongpata maw, to tih ai boeh loe nongpa ih haa maw, angkhaeksak nahaeloe, haa angkhaehsak pongah tamna to loihsak han oh.
Maitaw tae mah nongpa maw, nongpata maw takhueng moe, dueh nahaeloe, maitaw tae to thlung hoi vah maat han oh; to maitaw moi to caak han om ai; toe maitaw tawnkung loe loihsak han oh.
Toe to maitaw tae loe canghnii ah kami daeng vai boeh, tito maitaw tawnkung khaeah thuih pae boeh, toe tawnkung mah kahoih ah khenzawn ai pongah, nongpa maw, nongpata maw takhueng maat bae nahaeloe, maitaw tae to thlung hoi vah maat pacoengah, tawnkung doeh paduek han oh.
Toe phoisa rong nasoe, tiah thui o nahaeloe, thuih ih lok baktih toengah, a hinghaih to pahlong moe, atho rongsak han oh.
Maitaw tae mah capa maw, canu maw daeng nahaeloe, lokcaekhaih baktih toengah sak han oh.
Maitaw tae mah tamna nongpa maw, nongpata maw daeng nahaeloe, maitaw tae tawnkung mah maitaw tawnkung hanah phoisa shekel qui thumto paek pacoengah, maitaw tae to thlung hoi vah maat han oh.
Kami maeto mah tangqom to aphroe moe, suek sut maw, to tih ai boeh loe tangqom to takaeh moe, kraeng ai ah suek sut pongah, maitaw tae maw, laa hrang maw krah moeng nahaeloe,
tangqom toepkung mah maitaw hoi laa hrang ih atho to rong ueloe, kadueh maitaw to la tih.
Kami maeto ih maitaw tae mah minawk kalah ih maitaw tae to daeng moe, dueh nahaeloe, kahing maitaw tae to zaw hoi ueloe, atho amzet hoi pacoengah, kadueh maitaw tae ih atho doeh kangvan ah amzet hoi tih.
Toe to ih maitaw tae loe hmawhsaeng parai moe, canghnii ah doeh maitawnawk daeng tuektuek boeh, tiah panoek boeh, toe tawnkung mah pathlet ai ah suem sut nahaeloe, kadueh maitaw to angmah la ueloe, maitaw tae hoiah rong pae let tih.
Kami maeto mah maitaw tae maw, to tih ai boeh loe tuu maw, paquk moe boh ving, to tih ai boeh loe zaw ving nahaeloe, maitaw tae maeto zuengah maitaw tae pangato, tuu maeto zuengah tuu palito hoi rong han oh.
Kamqu mah im muk nathuem ah kamqu to bop maat nahaeloe, a nuiah athii palonghaih om mak ai.
Toe ni tacawt boeh nahaeloe, athii longsak pongah anih loe zae ah oh; kamqu loe paqukhaih atho to rong tih; toe tidoeh tawn ai nahaeloe, paqukhaih atho rong hanah angmah to angzawh han oh.
A paquk ih maitaw maw, to tih ai boeh loe laa hrang maw, to tih ai boeh loe tuu maw angmah ban ah hing vop nahaeloe, alet hnetto rong let tih.
Kami mah a tawnh ih moinawk to lawk ah maw, to tih ai boeh loe misur takha thungah maw pratsak, toe kahoih ah toep ai pongah, minawk ih lawk to caa nahaeloe, a lawk hoi misur takha thung ih kahoih koek hmuen hoiah pathok let tih.
Hmai thlaek naah hmai to cawnh moe, lawk ih cangqui maw, to tih ai boeh loe cangkung maw, to tih ai boeh loe lawk to kangh boih nahaeloe, hmai thlaek kami mah rong let tih.
Kami maeto mah a imtaeng kami khaeah phoisa maw, hmuen maw pakuemsak, toe anih imthung hoiah kamqu mah paquk pae ving moe, kamqu to naeh nahaeloe, anih mah alet hnetto rong nasoe.
Toe kamqu to hnu ai nahaeloe, im tawnkung mah a imtaeng ih hmuen to lak maw, la ai, tito panoek hanah, anih to lokcaekkungnawk hmaa ah kawk moe, lokcaek han oh.
Kami maeto mah maitaw tae maw, laa hrang maw, tuu maw, khukbuen maw, to tih ai boeh loe kanghmaa hmuen maw amsoem ai ah, Hae hmuen loe kai ih ni, tiah thui nahaeloe, nihnik to lokcaekkung khaeah caeh haih hmaek han oh; lokcaekkungnawk mah paqu kami ah net ih kami mah a imtaeng kami hanah alet hnetto pathok pae tih.
Kami maeto mah laa hrang maw, to tih ai boeh loe maitaw tae maw, to tih ai boeh loe tuu maw, to tih ai boeh loe kawbaktih moi doeh toepsak hanah a imtaeng kami khaeah aap, toe to moi to duek ving maw, to tih ai boeh loe ahmaa cak maw, to tih ai boeh loe minawk kalah mah huih ving pongah, mi mah doeh hnu ai nahaeloe,
moi toepsak kami mah, a imtaeng kami ih hmuen to ka la ai tiah, Angraeng hmaa ah lokkam nahaeloe, nihnik salak lokpunghaih to boengsak han oh; moi tawnkung mah to lok to talawk han oh, moi toep kami doeh rongsak han om ai.
Toe a imtaeng kami mah to moi to paqu nahaeloe, moi toep kami mah tawnkung hanah rong pae tih.
Toep ih moi to kalah moisan mah kaek ving nahaeloe, moisan mah kaek ving boeh, tiah hnukung to kawk ah, to tiah nahaeloe moisan mah kaek ving pongah atho rong mak ai.
Kami maeto mah hmuen maeto a imtaeng kami khaeah tlai, tawnkung om ai naah ahmaa cak, to tih ai boeh loe dueh ving nahaeloe, tlai kami mah pathok let tih.
Toe tawnkung om toeng nahaeloe, tlaikung mah pathok mak ai; toe atho hoiah tlai nahaeloe, tawnkung mah tlaihaih atho khue to hnik han oh.
Sava sak han ai ah lokkamhaih sah nongpata to nongpa maeto mah pacae khing moe, iip haih nahaeloe, nongpata avang to paek ueloe, nongpata to zu ah la tih.
Nongpata ih ampa mah a canu to anih zusak han koeh ai cadoeh, anih mah tangla ih avang to paek toengtoeng tih.
Ma-uih loe hingsak han om ai.

Angvin to pacaekthlaek hmah; anih to hnap doeh hnap hmah; nangcae doeh Izip prae thungah angvin ah ni na oh o toeng.
Lamhmainawk, to tih ai boeh loe naqahnawk to pacaekthlaek hmah.
Na pacaekthlaek pongah, nihcae mah kai khaeah qah o nahaeloe, nihcae qahhaih lok to ka tahngaih pae han.
Palung ka phui moe, nangcae sumsen hoiah kang hum o han; na zunawk to lamhmai ah om o ueloe, na caanawk doeh ampa tawn ai ah om o tih.
Na imtaeng ah kaom kamtang kai ih kaminawk khaeah phoisa na coisak nahaeloe, a caa kangpung paek hanah coisak hmah; kapung acaa na lak han om ai.
Na imtaeng kaminawk mah nang khaeah a khukbuen pawng nahaeloe, niduem ai naah thaak pae let ah;
anih loe a takpum padap hanah to khukbuen khue ni a tawnh; to tih ai nahaeloe a iih naah, timaw angkhuk tih? Anih mah kai khaeah hang nahaeloe, kai loe minawk tahmen thaih kami ah ka oh pongah, a hanghaih lok to ka tahngaih pae han.
sithawnawk to kasae thui hmah loe, nangmacae kami ukkung doeh tangoeng hmah.
Kahmin tangsuek thingthai hoi na pasawh tangsuek ih thingthai tui to akra ai ah paek ah, hawk ving hmah; na caanawk thungah tapen tangsuek calu to na paek ah.
To baktih toengah, maitaw tae hoi tuu doeh paek ah; amno khaeah ni sarihto omsak loe, ni tazetto naah kai khaeah na paek ah.
Nangcae loe kai khaeah ciimcai kami ah na om o tih; to pongah taw ah moisan mah kaek ih moi to caa o hmah; uinawk han paek oh.
Amsawnlok to haeh hmah; katoeng ai kami hoi amyok hmah loe, amsawn lok hnukung ah angdoe hmah.
Kasae hmuen sak hanah minawk hnuk ah bang hmah; lokcaekhaih hmuen ah nang doet naah, toenghaih amkhraeng taak hanah kapop kaminawk bang ah angdoe hmah;
lokcaek naah kamtang kami doeh mikhmai khen hmah.
Lam amkhraeng na misa ih maitaw tae maw, to tih ai boeh loe laa hrang maw na hnuk nahaeloe, angmah khaeah thaak pae let ah.
Nang hnuma kami ih laa hrang to hmuen kazit mah taeh caeng nahaeloe, caehtaak hmah, anih to abom ah.
Kamtang nangmah ih kami to lok na caek naah, amsoem ai ah lokcaek hmah.
Katoeng ai hmuen to ayae oh; kaom duem kami hoi zaehaih tawn ai kami to hum hmah; zaehaih sah kasae kami loe ka prawt sut mak ai.
Bokhaih ah paek ih tangqum to talawk hmah; bokhaih mah palungha kami ih mik to maengsak moe, katoeng kami ih lok to angkawnsak.
Angvin to pacaekthlaek hmah; nangcae doeh Izip prae ah angvin ah na oh o pongah, angvin ih palungthin to na panoek o.
Saning tarukto thung lawk sah oh loe, cang to aat oh;
toe saning sarihto naah loe lawk sah ai ah, lawk hmuen to anghaksak ah loe, kongsak ah; nangmacae thung ih amtang kaminawk mah caaknaek pakronghaih ah patoh o nasoe loe; nihcae mah caehtaak ih kanghmat to moinawk mah caa o nasoe. To tiah misur takha hoi olive takha doeh sah oh.
Ni tarukto thung nangmah ih tok to sah ah loe, ni sarihto naah loe anghak ah; nangmah ih maitaw tae hoi laa hrang doeh anghak ueloe, na imthung ah tapen na tamnanawk hoi angvin doeh anghak o nasoe.
Kang thuih o ih loknawk boih pongah acoe oh; kalah sithawnawk ih ahmin to thui o hmah; na pakha hoi thuih ih lok doeh minawk han thaih o sak hmah.
Saningto naah vai thumto buh raenghaih to sah oh.
Taeh thuh ai ih buh raenghaih poih to sah oh; (kang paek o ih lok baktih toengah, atue khaeh ih Abib khrah thungah, ni sarihto thung taeh thuh ai ih takaw caakhaih poih to sah oh; nangcae loe to khrah naah ni Izip prae thung hoiah na tacawt o; to buh raenghaih poih sak nathung, mi kawbaktih doeh ka hmaa ah bangkrai ah angphong han om ai:)
cangrawt tue ih poih loe na lawk thung hoi tacawt kathai tangsuek thingthai qumponawk hoiah sah oh loe, lawksak pacoeng, thingthai qumponawk lakhaih tue ah doeh sah oh.
Nangcae thung ih nongpa boih saningto naah vai thumto Angraeng hmaa ah angphong oh.
Angbawnhaih moi thii hoi taeh thuh ih takaw to nawnto na paek hmah. Angbawnhaih moithawk to akhawnbang khoek to anghmatsak hmah.
Na lawk thung ih hmaloe koek kathai kahoih koek thingthai to na Angraeng Sithaw im ah sin ah; maeh caa to amno ih tahnutui hoiah thong hmah.
Khenah, ka sak ih ahmuen ah kang caeh o haih hanah, loklam ah nangcae khenzawnkung, van kami nangcae hmaa ah ka patoeh.
Anih to khingya ah, a thuih ih lok to tahngai ah; anih to aek hmah; anih thungah Ka hmin oh pongah, anih mah na zaehaih to tahmen mak ai.
Toe a lok kahoih ah na tahngaih moe, ka thuih ih loknawk boih na sak nahaeloe, na misanawk to ka misa ah om tih, nangcae pakaa kaminawk to ka pakaa han.
Kai ih van kami to nangcae hmaa ah caeh ueloe, nangcae to Amor, Hit, Periz, Kanaan, Hiv hoi Jebus kaminawk ih prae ah na caeh haih tih; nihcae to kam rosak boih han.
Nihcae ih sithawnawk hmaa ah akuep hmah, bok hmah loe, nihcae ih tok doeh sah hmah; to hmuennawk to phrae ah loe, krangnawk doeh phrae boih ah.
Nang ih takaw hoi tui to tahamhoihaih ang paek hanah, na Angraeng Sithaw to bok oh; na tak thung ih nathaih doeh kang lak pae ving tih.
Na prae thungah, caa kamro hoi caa kaak maeto doeh om mak ai; na hing thung khosakhaih ka koepsak han.
Kai zithaih nangcae hmaa ah ka patoeh moe, na phak o ih ahmuen kruekah kaom kaminawk to kam rosak han; na misanawk to hnukbang ah kam laemsak boih han.
Hiv, Kanaan hoi Hit kaminawk to haek hanah, nangcae hmaa ah khoilangae to ka patoeh han.
Saningto thungah to kaminawk to nangcae hmaa hoi ka haek mak ai; to tiah ka sak nahaeloe prae thungah kami angqai krang ueloe, taw ih moinawk to pung o aep moeng tih.
Nang pung o moe, prae thung boih na koi o ai karoek to, to kaminawk to zetta, zetta hoiah ni ka haek han.
Na ramri loe tuipui kathim hoiah Philistin tuipui karoek to, praezaek hoiah vapui khoek to ka suek han; to prae thungah kaom kaminawk to na ban ah kang paek han, nangmacae hmaa hoiah nihcae to na haek o tih.
Nihcae hoi maw nihcae ih sithawnawk hoiah maw lokkamhaih to sah hmah.
Nihcae mah ka nuiah zaehaih ang sak o sak han ai ah, nihcae to na prae thungah omsak hmah; nihcae ih sithawnawk to na bok nahaeloe, nang han patung ih thaang ah om tih, tiah a naa.
To pacoengah Mosi khaeah, Nangmah hoi Aaron, Nadab, Abihu hoi Israel kacoehta qui sarihto Angraeng khaeah angzo o tahang ah, nihcae loe ahmuen kangthla hoiah bok o nasoe.
Mosi khue ni Angraeng taengah caeh tih; kalah kaminawk loe a taengah caeh o hmah; kaminawk doeh anih hoi nawnto caeh o hmah nasoe, tiah a naa.
Mosi mah caeh moe, kaminawk khaeah lokcaekhaih hoi Angraeng ih loknawk boih to thuih naah, kaminawk boih mah, Angraeng mah thuih ih lok to ka sak o boih han, tiah nawnto a thuih o.
Angraeng mah thuih ih loknawk boih loe Mosi mah tarik; khawnbang khawnthaw ah angthawk moe, mae tlim ah hmaicam maeto a sak pacoengah, Israel acaeng hathlai hnetto angmathaih thlung hathlai hnetto a tling.
To pacoengah anih mah Israel thendoengnawk to patoeh, nihcae mah maitaw tae to lak o moe, Angraeng khaeah hmai angbawnhaih hoi angdaeh angbawnhaih to a sak o.
Mosi mah athii ahap to lak moe, boengloeng pongah suek; athii ahap lak moe, hmaicam nuiah a haeh.
Anih mah lokmaihaih cabu to lak pacoengah, kaminawk hanah kroek pae; kaminawk mah Angraeng mah thuih ih loknawk to ka sak o boih moe, lok ka tahngai o han, tiah a naa o.
To pacoengah Mosi mah athii to lak moe, kaminawk nuiah haeh pacoengah, Khenah, hae ih loknawk baktih toengah, hae loe Angraeng mah nangcae hoi sak ih lokmaihaih athii ah oh, tiah a naa.
Mosi, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu hoi Israel kacoehta qui sarihtonawk loe caeh o tahang moe,
Israel Sithaw to a hnuk o; a khok atlim bangah loe sapphire thlung kanglung hoi baih het ih hmuen baktiah oh moe, kacai pin van baktiah amdueng.
Toe Sithaw loe Israel kacoehtanawk bangah ban payangh ai; nihcae mah Sithaw to hnuk o, a caak o moe, naek o.
Angraeng mah Mosi khaeah, Kai khaeah mae ah angzo tahang ah loe, haeah om ah; kaminawk to na patuk hanah, thlung kangphaek nuiah ka tarik ih, lokpaekhaih hoi kaalok to kang paek han, tiah a naa.
To pacoengah Mosi loe anih bomkung Joshua hoi nawnto amsak hoi; Mosi loe Sithaw ih mae ah dawh tahang.
Anih mah kacoehtanawk khaeah, Nangcae khae kang zo hoi let ai karoek to haeah na zing oh; khenah, Aaron hoi Hur loe nangcae hoi nawnto oh; lokthuih han tawn kami loe nihnik khaeah caeh oh, tiah a naa.
Mosi mae ah caeh tahang naah, mae loe tamai mah khuk khoep.
Angraeng lensawkhaih loe Sinai mae ah oh; ni tarukto thung tamai mah mae to khuk khoep; ni sarihto naah loe Angraeng mah Mosi to tamai thung hoiah kawk.
Angraeng lensawkhaih loe, Israel kaminawk mikhnuk ah mae nuiah kangqong hmai baktiah aang.
Mosi loe tamai thungah caeh moe, mae nui a phak pacoengah, to ah ni qui palito hoi qum qui palito oh.
Angraeng mah Mosi khaeah,
Israel kaminawk mah Kai khaeah hmuen sin o hanah thui paeh, tiah a naa. Kami boih mah palung huemhaih hoiah paek ih hmuen to kai hanah talawk ah.
Nihcae khae hoi na lak han ih hmuennawk loe sui, sum kanglung hoi sum kamling,
rong kam-iing, rong kamling hup hoi kathim kahni, puu tlangqui hoi maeh mui,
kamling tui nup ih tuu tae ih ahin hoi caham hin, shittim thing,
hmai paanghaih situi, bawh ih hmuihoih situi, hmai thlaek koi hmuihoih,
Onyx thlungnawk, qaima ih kahni hoi saoek ah takaek ih thlungnawk to talawk ah.
Nangcae salakah ka oh hanah, kai han hmuenciim to sah ah.
Kang patuek ih kahni im hoi hmuennawk ih krang baktih toengah sah ah.
Kasawk dongto pacoeng ahap, ka kawk dongto pacoeng ahap, ka sang dongto pacoeng ahap kaom, thingkhong maeto shittim thing hoiah sah ah.
To thingkhong to sui hoi pazut ah, athung doeh tasa bang doeh sui hoi pazut loe, aqai taeng boih sui hoiah sah ah.
Sui hoiah aqai kangbuet luet palito sah ah loe, thingkhong takii palito ah suem boih ah; takii maeto pongah kangbuet luet hnetto suem ah.
Shittim thing hoiah aputhaih thing to sah loe, sui tui pazut ah.
Thingkhong aput hanah aputhaih thing loe sui hoi sak ih kangbuet luet akhaw thungah hawt ah.
Aputhaih thingnawk loe thingkhong aqai ah suek ih kangbuet luet akhaw thungah suem poe ah, azuk ving hmah.
To thingkhong thungah kang paek han ih hnukung to suem ah.
Kasawk dong hnetto pacoeng ahap, ka kawk dong maeto pacoeng ahap kaom, palungnathaih tangkhang loe kaciim sui hoiah sah ah.
Cherubim hnetto sui hoiah sah loe, angtaeng koek palungnathaih tangkhang suekhaih ahmuen ah suem ah.
Cherub maeto loe hae bang ih ahmuen kangtaeng ah suem ah loe, kalah maeto loe ho bang ih kangtaeng ahmuen ah suem ah; cherubim loe hae bang hoi ho bang ih palungnathaih tangkhang taengah suem hmaek ah.
Cherubim ih pakhraehnawk to mikhmai kangtong ah suem ah loe, palungnathaih tangkhang bangah anghaesak ah; pakhraeh to phoksak tahang ah loe, palungnathaih tangkhang to pakhraeh hoi khuksak ah.
Palungnathaih tangkhang to thingkhong nuiah suemh loe, to thingkhong thungah kang paek ih hnukung to suem ah.
Hnukung suekhaih thingkhong nuiah kaom, cherubim hnetto salakah, nang to kang tongh moe, palungnathaih tangkhang ranuih hoiah nang khaeah lok ka thuih han; Israel kaminawk hanah ka paek ih loknawk boih nang khaeah kang paek han.
Kasawk dong hnetto, kakawk dong maeto, kasang dong maeto pacoeng ahap kaom, caboi maeto shittim thing hoiah sah ah.
Kaciim sui hoi pazut ah loe, aqai taeng boih sui hoiah sah ah.
Aqai karto sah ah loe, aqai taeng boih sui hoiah sah ah.
To caboi aqai ah kangbuet luet palito sui hoiah sah loe, akhok palito ranuih caboi takii palito ah suem ah.
To sui hoiah sak ih kangbuet luet palito loe, aqai ah oh pongah caboi aput han thing hawthaih akhaw ah om tih.
Caboi aputhaih cung to shittim thing hoiah sah loe, to aputhaih thing to sui hoiah pazut ah.
To ih caboi ah patoh han ih sabaenawk, kathlahnawk, kraenghaih akhuemnawk, sabae kathuknawk to sah ah; tui bawhhaih boengloeng doeh sui hoiah sah ah.
Ka hmaa ih caboi nuiah takaw to suem poe ah.
Hmaithawk paanghaih to kaciim sui hoiah sah loe, tung hoi a bannawk, boengloengnawk, apawk hoi apawk tangmuem krangnawk to soi ah.
Hmaithawk paanghaih tung maeto bangah a ban thumto tacawt ueloe, kalah maeto bangah doeh a ban thumto, sangqum boih ah tarukto tacawtsak ah.
Hmaithawk paanghaih tung thung hoi tacawt ban thumto oh, a ban maeto naah almond apawk hoi apawk tangmuem baktih kaom, boengloeng krang thumto soi ah loe, kalah ban maeto pongah doeh almond apawk hoi apawk tangmuem baktih kaom, boengloeng krang thumto soi ah; to tiah hmaithawk paanghaih tung hoi tacawt ban tarukto nuiah soi boih ah.
Hmai paanghaih tung pongah doeh almond apawk hoi apawk tangmuem baktih kaom, boengloeng krang palito soi han angaih.
Hmaithawk paanghaih tung maeto thung hoiah ban tarukto tacawt baktih toengah, a ban maeto atlim ah apawk tangmuem krang maeto, a ban hnetto tlim ah apawk tangmuem krang maeto, a ban thumto tlim ah doeh apawk tangmuem krang maeto soi boih han oh.
Apawk tangmuem hoi hmaithawk paanghaih tung hoiah tacawt a bannawk to anghmongsak boih ah; to hmuen to kaciim sui hoiah ah sah boih ah.
To pacoengah hmai-im sarihto sah loe, caboi aangsak hanah, hmaiim to paang ah.
Taitaeh hoi taitaeh suekhaih doeh kaciim sui hoiah sah ah.
Hmai paanghaih tung hoi kalah hmuennawk sak haih boih hanah, sui talent maeto patoh ah.
Mae ah kang patuek ih krang baktih toengah, sak azom ah, tiah a naa.
Kahni im loe rong kam-iing, kamling hup hoi kathim, bantok sak kop kaminawk mah sak ih cherubim kaom, imthung pakaahaih puu ngan kahni hato hoiah sah ah.
Imthung pakaahaih kahni loe dong pumphae tazetto sawk moe, dong palito kawk han oh; imthung pakaahaih kahni loe dong tahhaih anghmong boih han oh.
Imthung pakaahaih kahni pangato pacong boih ah loe, kalah kahni pangato doeh pacong bae ah.
Imthung pakaahaih kahni tasa bang ih, kahni maeto hoi maeto patomhhaih aqai taengah, rong kam-iing hoiah kangbuet luet akhaw to sah ah; kalah kahni pongah doeh kahni maeto hoi maeto paconghaih aqai taengah, to tiah sah let ah.
Payang ih kahni maeto pongah kangbuet luet akhaw qui pangato sah loe, kalah kahni paconghaih ahmuen ah doeh kangbuet luet akhaw qui pangato sah let ah.
To pacoengah kahni ataephaih doeh sui hoiah qui pangato sah loe, to kahni ataephaih hoiah kahni to maeto pacoeng maeto pacong ah; to naah kahni im maeto ah angcoeng tih.
Kahni im ranuih khuk hanah imthung pakaahaih kahni to maeh mui hoiah sah ah.
Imthung pakaahaih kahni loe dong qui thumto sawk moe, dong palito kawksak han oh; kahni hathlaito loe kalen kasawk anghmong boih tih.
Kahni pangato to maeto ah pacong ah loe, kalah kahni tarukto doeh maeto ah patomh ah; tarukto haih kahni loe hnetto ah pakhraep ah loe kahni im hmaa ah suem ah.
Kahni maeto hoi maeto paconghaih aqai ah kangbuet luet akhaw qui pangato sah loe, kalah kahni maeto patomhhaih aqai ah doeh kangbuet luet akhaw qui pangato sah let ah.
Sum kamling hoiah ataephaih to qui pangato ah sah loe, kangbuet luet akhaw qui pangato pongah pathlet boih ah.
Kahni im ah payang ih kamtlai kahni ahap loe, kahni im hnukbang ah bang ah.
Kahni im ah payang ih kamthlai kahni loe maeto bangah kasawk dong maeto, kalah maeto bangah doeh kasawk dong maeto om tih; to tiah kamtlai kahni hoiah kahni im to khuk ah.
Kahni im khuk hanah tuu hin kamling to patoh ah loe, tuipui caham hin hoiah a nui to khuk ah.
Kahni im tapang to shittim thingphaek hoiah sah ah.
Thingphaek maeto loe dong hato sawk moe, dong maeto pacoeng, ahap kawksak han oh.
Thingphaek maeto pongah akhok hnetto sah loe, kangvan ah suem ah; to tiah kahni im ih thingphaek boih pongah sah ah.
Kahni im aloih bang pakaa hanah thingphaek pumphaeto sah ah;
to thingphaek pumphaeto atlim ah thingphaek maeto pongah akhok hnetto pahnut hanah, sum kanglung hoiah akhok pahnuthaih akhaw qui palito sah ah.
Kahni im aluek bang pakaa hanah thingphaek pumphaeto suem ah;
akhok pahnut hanah sum kanglung hoiah akhaw qui palito sah ah; thingphaek maeto pongah akhok hnetto sah boih ah.
Kahni im niduem bangah thingphaek tarukto sah ah.
Kahni im boenghaih takii tapang haih hanah, thingphaek hnetto sah ah.
Takii hnetto loe atlim hoi ranuih nawnto pacong tahang poe ah loe ahmuen maeto ah caehsak hmaek ah; takii hnetto loe to tiah om tih.
Thingphaek tazetto om ueloe, sum kanglung hoi sak ih akhok pahnuthaih ahmuen hathlai tarukto oh han angaih; thingphaek maeto pongah akhok hnetto om ueloe, kalah thingphaek maeto pongah doeh akhok hnetto om toeng tih.
Takraenghaih thing to shittim thing hoiah sah ah; kahni im maeto ah takraenghaih pangato sah ah.
Kahni im maeto bangah takraenghaih pangato sah loe, kahni im boenghaih niduem bangah takraenghaih pangato sah let ah.
A um takraenghaih thingphaek loe hae bang hoi ho bang boenghaih khoek to phasak ah.
Thingphaeknawk loe sui tui hoi pazut boih ah; takraenghaih thingphaek hawthaih ahmuen doeh sui hoiah sah ah; takraenghaih thingphaek doeh sui tui pazut ah.
Mae nuiah kang patuek ih krang baktih toengah, kahni im to sah ah.
Pakaahaih kahni loe rong kamiing, kamling hup, kathim puu ngan hoiah sah loe, bantok sak kop kami khaeah cherubim krang to soisak ah;
sui tui pazut ih shittim tung palito nuiah, to imthung pakaahaih kahni to bang ah; to tungnawk pongah sui hoi sak ih cakoih baktih kaom racahnawk, sum kanglung hoi sak ih akhok pahnuthaih ahmuen palito sah ah.
Hnukung suekhaih thingkhong loe kahni hoi pakaa ih imthung ah suek hanah, payang ih kahni to sui hoi sak ih kahni ataephaih atlim ah bang ah; payang ih kahni mah hmuenciim hoi ciimcai koek ahmuen to pakaa khoep tih.
Palungnathaih tangkhang loe kaciim koek ahmuen thung ih hnukung thingkhong nuiah suem ah.
Payang ih kahni tasa bangah caboi to suem ah loe, kahni im aloih bangah hmaithawk, aluek bangah caboi to mikhmai kangtong ah suem ah.
Kahni im akunhaih pakaa hanah, kahni loe rong kamiing, rong kamling hup hoi kathim puu ngan hoiah sah ah.
Payang ih kahni to bangh hanah tung pangato shittim thing hoiah sah ah; to tungnawk to sui tui pazut ah; cakoih baktih kaom racahnawk doeh sui hoi sak han angaih; akhok pahnuthaih ahmuen pangato loe sum kanglung hoiah sah ah.
Dong pangato ka sawk, dong pangato kawk, hmaicam maeto shittim thing hoiah sah ah; hmaicam loe kasawk hoi kalen anghmong moe, dong thumnto sang han oh.
Hmaicam ih taki palito ah takii maeto sah boih loe, hmaicam pong ih takii loe anghmongsak boih ah; hmaicam to sum kamling tui hoiah pazut ah.
To ah maiphu sohhaih laomnawk, kathuk sabaenawk, moi sohhaih cakoih baktih kaom sumnawk, hmaitikhaih laomnawk hoi laom sabaenawk boih sum kamling hoiah sah ah.
Hmai hawhhaih loe sum kamling hoiah sah ah loe, hmai hawhhaih takii palito nuiah akhaw kangbuet luet to sum kamling hoiah sah ah.
Hmai hawhhaih loe hmaicam angkoihaih atlim, a um ah suem ah.
Hmaicam aputhaih thing loe shittim thing hoiah sah ah loe, sum kamling tui pazut ah.
Hmaicam aputhaih thing loe hmaicam maeto bang hoi kalah maeto bang ih akhaw thungah hawt ah loe, to tiah suem poe ah.
Hmaicam um ah akhaw pahoe ah, mae nuiah kang patuek ih krang baktih toengah sah ah.
Kahni im longhma to sah ah; dong cumvaito kasawk puu kahni hoiah aloih bang to pakaa ah.
Tung pumphaeto sah ah loe, sum kamling hoiah tung pahnuthaih ahmuen pumphaeto sah ah, tung pong ih cakoih baktih kaom, sum hoi paehhaihnawk loe sum kamling hoiah sah ah.
To baktih toengah aluek bangah doeh dong cumvaito kasawk payang ih kahni to sah ah; sum kamling hoiah tung pumphaeto hoi tung pahnuthaih ahmuen pumphaeto sah ah; tung pong ih cakoih baktih kaom, sum hoi paehhaihnawk loe sum kanglung hoiah sah ah.
Longhma niduem bang loe dong qui pangato kawk tih, tung hato oh moe, tung pahnuthaih ahmuen doeh hato sak han oh.
Ni tacawthaih ni angyae bang ih longhma doeh dong qui pangato kawk han angaih.
Thok maeto bang pakaa hanah, dong hathlai pangato kasawk imthung pakaahaih kahni hoi nawnto ah, tung thumto hoi akhok pahnuthaih ahmuen thumto oh han ngaih.
Kalah maeto bangah doeh dong hathlai pangato kasawk, pakaa ih kahni hoi nawnto ah, tung thumto hoi tung pahnuthaih ahmuen thumto oh han angaih.
Longhma akunhaih thok taeng pakaa haih hanah rong kamiing, rong kamling hup hoi kathim puu ngan hoiah sak ih dong pumphaeto kasawk kahni to om tih; tung palito om ueloe, tung pahnuthaih ahmuen palito om tih.
Sum kanglung hoiah longhma taeng kaom tungnawk hoi paehhaihnawk boih to sah ah; cakoih baktih kaom sum to sum kanglung hoiah sah ah loe, tung pahnuthaih ahmuen leo sum kamling hoiah sah ah.
Longhmaa loe kasawk dong cumvaito, kakawk dong qui pangato om ueloe, kasang dong pangato om tih; puu ngan hoi tung pahnuthaih ahmuen loe sum kamling hoiah sah ah.
Kahni imthung ah patoh ih hmuennawk boih, toksak naah patoh ih hmuennawk boih, kahni im sakhaih sumnawk boih, longhma ah patoh ih sumnawk boih to sum kamling hoiah sah ah.
